moves.name: Half Truths
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Aalto fires up to 5 consecutive shots, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Basic Attack 4 will spread the <te href=850048>Mist</te> forward, which lasts for {0}s.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Aalto enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Aalto consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Shift Trick
moves.description:
<color=Title>Mist Avatar</color>
Casts <te href=850048>Mist</te> and {0} "Mist Avatar(s)" to taunt the surrounding targets. The avatars inherit a portion of Aalto's HP and generate {1} Mist Bullets around them, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mist Bullets</color>
Deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

moves.name: Flower in the Mist
moves.description: Generate a <te href=850049>Gate of Quandary</te> in front, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. When bullets pass through the Gate of Quandary, they deal increased DMG. Gate of Quandary lasts for {0}s.

moves.name: Feint Shot
moves.description: Aalto shows up out of thin air to perform rapid continuous shooting, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Dissolving Mist
moves.description: The incoming Resonator has their Aero DMG Amplified by {0} for {1}s or until they are switched out.

moves.name: Tune Break: Pistols
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Misty Cover
moves.description:
When Aalto passes through "Mist" or "Gate of Quandary", he enters the <color=Highlight>Mistcloak Dash</color>.

<color=Title>Mistcloak Dash</color>
-Movement speed increased;
-During this period, "Mist Drops" are continuously consumed, and for each {0} "Mist Drop" consumed, {1} Mist Bullet(s) is generated.

<color=Title>Mist Drops</color>
Aalto can hold up to {2} "Mist Drops".
When <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> passes through "Mist" and hits the target, {3} "Mist Drop" is recovered.

moves.name: Perfect Performance
moves.description: Aalto's <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will always critically hit, triggered once every {0}s.

moves.name: Mid-game Break
moves.description: Aalto will continuously recover STA when he is in the Forte Circuit <color=Highlight>Mistcloak Dash</color> state.

moves.name: Infinity Calibration
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack - Aemeath</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to charge the attack by consuming STA, release to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged I</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> longer to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color>, dealing higher <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
When in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color> charges more quickly. Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>.
This Skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged I</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Aemeath</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color>.

values.name: Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged I DMG
Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II DMG

moves.name: Shared Voyage
moves.description:
<color=Title>Form Switch</color>
Aemeath can switch forms between herself and her Mech. The Mech inherits Aemeath's Stats and unlocks new moves.
Aemeath automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stage 1</color> upon casting <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color>.
While in the Mech form, Aemeath casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> automatically upon casting <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> in mid-air.

<color=Title>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2, 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill. Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2, 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Mech</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
Switch into Aemeath after casting this skill. Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Mech</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>
Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button to charge by consuming STA, release to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged I</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button longer to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, dealing higher <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
When in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color> charges more quickly. Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>.
This Skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged I</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Mech</color>
Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground

values.name: Sync Strike: Call of Dawn DMG
Heavy Attack - Mech Charged I DMG
Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II DMG

moves.name: Towards the Daybreak
moves.description:
<color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color>
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Switch into Mech form after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Casting this skill grants the following effects:
- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121002>Stardust Resonance</te></color> for {0}s.
- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> for {1}s.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to perform Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
The next <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> cast within {2}s after casting this skill doesn't consume <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.

<color=Title>Stardust Resonance</color>
Enhance the effect of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>.
This effect ends after <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> is cast {3} times.

<color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color>
<color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color>.
When in <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> reaches the limit, enter <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>. <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> is removed when the <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> state ends.

<color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> when the following conditions are met:
- Be in the <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> state.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.
Casting this skill depletes all <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, and ends the <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> state and <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state.
Switch back to Aemeath after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

moves.name: Overture of Departure
moves.description:
<color=Title>Songs Across the Universe</color>
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Cast this skill to enter <color=Highlight><te href=121006>Starlume Acceleration</te></color> for {0}s.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3</color> automatically.

<color=Title>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>
In the Mech form, <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Casting this skill grants <color=Highlight><te href=121006>Starlume Acceleration</te></color> for {0}s.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3</color> automatically.

<color=Title>Starlume Acceleration</color>
In <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>, casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> addtionally restores <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> ends <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>.

values.name: Songs Across the Universe Concerto Regen
Debut of Meteoric Radiance Concerto Regen

moves.name: Silent Protection
moves.description:
When casting this skill, the following effects are triggered based on the <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color> Aemeath is in:
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>: all Resonators in the team except Aemeath gain {0} All-DMG Amplification for {1}s. The All-DMG Amplification effect is increased to {2} for Resonators who inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>.
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>: all Resonators in the team except Aemeath gain {0} All-DMG Amplification for {1}s. The All-DMG Amplification effect is increased to {2} for Resonators who inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>.
Casting this skill resets the effects above.

moves.name: Unlanded Melody
moves.description:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Aemeath can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>: when Resonators in the team trigger <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target and cause them to be affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, Aemeath triggers <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color>. The same target can only be damaged by this skill once every {0}s.

moves.name: To Sculpt the Silence
moves.description:
<color=Title>Seraphic Duo</color>
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> for {1}s.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture</color>
When Aemeath is in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore</color>
In the Mech form, when in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Mode</color>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, inflict {2} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> on the target for {4}s, stacking up to {3} times.

- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, inflict {5} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up to {6} times.
While in combat, when the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on targets near the active Resonator reaches {8} stacks, inflict {9} stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>. If the targets have more than {10} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.

In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every {27}s:
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.

Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals {11} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against the target is increased by {12}. This effect lasts for {28}s. The target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> stacks on targets if they are inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, and trigger the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target by {13}.

When in <color=Highlight>Stardust Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> additionally deal {14} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> on the main target is additionally increased by {15}. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.

<color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color>
Active in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>. Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets within range that are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG.

<color=Title>Starflux Thrust</color>
When in the Mech form and <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is more than {16}, use the Utility button to cast <color=Highlight>Starflux Thrust</color> and soar in the air by continuously consuming <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color>.

<color=Title>Synchronization Rate</color>
<color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> is capped at {17} points.
- Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Mech</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color> recovers <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color> and <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color> recovers {18} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {19} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> at the same time, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> recovers {21} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Rate</color>
<color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color> is capped at {22} points.
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> recovers {23} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {24} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>, casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> additionally recovers {25} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.

<color=Title>Starflux</color>
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> is capped at {26} points.
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> recovers naturally over time.

moves.name: Before All Sounds
moves.description: In <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color> gain {0} DMG Amplification.

moves.name: Between the Stars
moves.description:
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or deal <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, Aemeath's Crit. DMG increases by {0}, up to {1} times. Each Resonator can only trigger this effect once.
With {2} stacks, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> DMG is Amplified by {3}.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, Aemeath's Crit. DMG increases by {4}, up to {5} times. Each Resonator can only trigger this effect once.
With {6} stacks, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> DMG is Amplified by {7}.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

moves.name: Hunter's Path
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> shortly after performing Heavy Attack to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Dodge Counter</color>
<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> after a successful Mid-air Dodge to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep</color>
When <te href=130602>Prowess</te> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.
- While in action, <color=Highlight>release</color> or <color=Highlight>press Normal Attack</color> again within a certain period to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color> is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color>
Augusta whirls and lashes out with her Broadblade, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color>

When Substance is full, enter the <color=Highlight>Final Bow</color> state.
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Era of New Wave</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fatal Finale</color> by {14}. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> or when <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> ends.

<color=Title>Substance</color>
Carlotta can hold up to {2} points of Substance.
Cannot gain Substance while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore {3} points of Substance upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>.
Restore {5} points of Substance for every {4} Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Chromatic Splendor</color>.
Restore {5} points of Substance for every {4} Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Necessary Measures</color>.
Consume {4} Moldable Crystal and restore {12} points of Substance upon casting <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.

<color=Title>Moldable Crystal</color>
Carlotta can hold up to {6} Moldable Crystals.
Cannot gain Moldable Crystal while in <color=Highlight>Twilight Tango</color> triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore {7} Moldable Crystals upon casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Restore {11} Moldable Crystals upon casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
Restore {8} Moldable Crystals upon casting Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Customary Greetings</color>.
Restore {13} Moldable Crystals upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>.
Restore {9} Moldable Crystals upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Art of Violence</color>.
Restore {10} Moldable Crystals upon a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.

moves.name: Flawless Purity
moves.description:
After casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Chromatic Splendor</color>, Carlotta can perform <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attacks</color> while being immune to any DMG or interruptions before the Mid-air Attack deals DMG.
When Carlotta is on the team, the active Resonator's Flight STA cost is reduced by {0}.

moves.name: Ars Gratia Artis
moves.description: Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Wintertime Aria</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Chromatic Splendor</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Death Knell</color>, and Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Imminent Oblivion</color> can inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850019>Deconstruction</te></color>.

moves.name: Sword to Carve My Forms
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Following <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit and summon <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color>.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and summoning <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color>. Can be performed in mid-air.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color>
Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, also considered <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after the <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> recalls all <color=Highlight>Sword Shadows</color>. Based on the types and number of <color=Highlight> Sword Shadows</color> recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color>, and <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color>
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Sword to Bear Their Names
moves.description:
<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Cartethyia</color>
Attack the target, launch nearby enemies, and then plunge them to the ground, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and inflicting 2 stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the targets hit. This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. Can be performed in mid-air.
Following <color=Highlight>Cartethyia - Resonance Skill</color>, summon <color=Highlight><te href=850184>Sword of Virtue's Shadow</te></color>.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850184>Sword of Virtue's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

moves.name: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
moves.description:
<color=Title>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color>
By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, unlocking new moves and entering the <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> clears all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>.
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> instantly trigger 1 instance of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG and reduce the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> attacks restore <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> reaches 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.

When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to transform back into <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>. When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4</color> will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> resistance to interruption increases.
<color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
<color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> or after <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> deals damage, raise the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
<color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.

<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> will transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> during <color=Highlight>quest dialogues</color>, <color=Highlight>environmental interaction animations</color>, or using <color=Highlight>Utilities</color>.
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.

<color=Title>Avatar - Cartethyia</color>
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, when <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, press Resonance Liberation to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color> and temporarily transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>, which pauses the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color>.

<color=Title>Avatar - Fleurdelys</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting Resonance Liberation as <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> performs <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, which resumes the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>
When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, ends <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.
Can be cast in mid-air.

moves.description:
<color=Title>Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace</color>
Deal Aero DMG and inflict 2 stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit. Summon <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color>.

Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom</color>
Thrust forward to impale the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color>.

moves.name: Wind's Divine Blessing
moves.description: <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> dealt by the active Resonator in the team other than <color=Highlight>Cartethyia/Fleurdelys</color> to targets with <te href=850180>Negative Statuses</te> is Amplified by 17.5% for 20s.

moves.name: Tune Break: Sword
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Tempest
moves.description:
<color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> unlocks new moves when she transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>:

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color>
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>
<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
While airborne, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.
While airborne, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> resets the cycle of <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Thrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>
While casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> again to cast Enhanced <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Upward Cut - Fleurdelys</color>.

<color=Title>Upward Cut - Fleurdelys</color>
While <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> is on the ground, <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys</color>
<color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys</color>.
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 </color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color>
<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color>.
Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color>
Following <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call</color>, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to ground targets, and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.
Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.
The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air.
