moves.name: A Heart's Truest Wishes
moves.description: The healing received by all Resonators other than <color=Highlight>Cartethyia/Fleurdelys</color> in the team is increased by 20% and their resistance to interruption is enhanced. If Rover: Aero is in the team, Rover: Aero additionally restores 25 <color=Highlight>Windstrings</color> upon casting <color=Highlight>Omega Storm</color>.

moves.name: Wind's Indelible Imprint
moves.description: Targets with 1 to 3 stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> take 30% more DMG from <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> and <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>. Targets with more than 3 stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> additionally take 10% more DMG from <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> and <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> for each stack of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> they have, up to 3 stacks.

moves.name: Blazing Enlightment
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
After releasing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight><te href=850003>True Sight</te></color>, lasting for 12s.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume Stamina to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
After releasing <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight><te href=850003>True Sight</te></color>, lasting for 12s.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> on the ground to perform an upward strike at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within a certain time to release <color=Highlight>Mid-Air Attack 3</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>
Shortly after holding <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> in mid-air or using Basic Attack <color=Highlight>True Sight: Charge</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform a plunging attack at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within a certain time to release <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 3</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

moves.name: Tripartite Flames
moves.description:
<color=Title>True Sight: Capture</color>
After releasing <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, Changli dashes towards the enemy and enters <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, lasting for 12s. In the end, she releases a plunging attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>True Sight: Capture</color> has 2 initial charges and holds up to 2 charges at maximum. The number of charges is replenished by 1 every 12s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Basic Attack: True Sight - Conquest</color>
When in <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, if Changli uses <color=Highlight>Ground Basic Attack</color>, she releases <color=Highlight>True Sight: Conquest</color>, dashing towards the enemy and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing <color=Highlight>True Sight: Conquest</color>, <color=Highlight>True Sight</color> ends.

<color=Title>Basic Attack: True Sight - Charge</color>
When in <color=Highlight>True Sight</color>, if Changli <color=Highlight>jumps</color> or uses <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> in mid-air, she releases <color=Highlight>True Sight: Charge</color>, dashing towards the enemy and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG. After releasing <color=Highlight>True Sight: Charge</color>, <color=Highlight>True Sight</color> ends.

moves.name: Radiance of Fealty
moves.description:
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to nearby targets, obtaining 4 stacks of Enflamement, and entering <color=Highlight>Fiery Feather</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Fiery Feather</color>
When Changli releases Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Flaming Sacrifice</color> within 10s, her ATK is increased by {0}, after which <color=Highlight>Fiery Feather</color> ends.

moves.name: Secret Strategist
moves.description: When casting Basic Attack: <color=Highlight>True Sight - Conquest</color> or Basic Attack: <color=Highlight>True Sight - Charge</color>, each stack of <te href=850004>Enflamement</te> will increase Fusion DMG Bonus by {0}.

moves.name: Tune Break: Sword
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Sweeping Force
moves.description: Casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Flaming Sacrifice</color> or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Radiance of Fealty</color> gives {0} Fusion DMG Bonus and ignores {1} of the target's DEF when dealing damage.

moves.name: Obedience of Rules
moves.description: Changli appears in mid-air, attacks the target, and enters <color=Highlight><te href=850003>True Sight</te></color>, lasting for 12s.

moves.name: Strategy of Duality
moves.description: The incoming Resonator has their Fusion DMG Amplified by {0} and Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by {1} for {2}s or until the Resonator is switched out.

moves.name: Flaming Sacrifice
moves.description:
<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Flaming Sacrifice</color>
When releasing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, if Changli carries 4 stacks of Enflamement, she consumes all stacks of Enflamement to cast <color=Highlight>Flaming Sacrifice</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
While casting <color=Highlight>Flaming Sacrifice</color>, Changli takes {0} less DMG.

<color=Title>Enflamement</color>
Changli can hold up to 4 stacks of Enflamement.
Changli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: <color=Highlight>True Sight - Conquest</color> on hit.
Changli obtains 1 stack of Enflamement for every Basic Attack: <color=Highlight>True Sight - Charge</color> on hit.
Changli obtains 4 stacks of Enflamement for every Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Radiance of Fealty</color>.

moves.name: Reign of Silence
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.

<color=Title>Rending Lunge</color>
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.
Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.

<color=Title>Death Snip</color>
Open the scissors, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during this skill to deal additional <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.

<color=Title>Thread Withdrawn</color>
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
This skill cannot be cast while in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>:
- Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>;
- Cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> and press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color>
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Hanging Finality</color>.
If interrupted, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Severed Facet</color> can be cast again by holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

<color=Title>Hanging Finality</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Death Snip</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color>
Hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color> to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, after casting this skill, Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> on the ground or use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. This effect is removed when Chisa enters <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Fractured Composition
moves.description:
<color=Title>Eye of Unraveling</color>
Stagnate and deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, after casting this skill, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> on the ground or use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>. This effect is removed when Chisa enters <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and on the ground, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Serrated Loop</color>
While on the ground and <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Serrated Loop</color>.
Stagnate targets, and deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and pull in nearby targets.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and replaces <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> with <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>.

moves.name: Moment of Nihility
moves.description:
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into <color=Highlight><te href=150805>Woven Myriad - Convergence</te></color> for {0}s.
While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Title>Woven Myriad - Convergence</color>
The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> are increased by {1}.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> granted by <color=Highlight>Sawring- Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> when <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> is consumed additionally increases by {2}.
Casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> ends <color=Highlight>Woven Myriad - Convergence</color>.

moves.name: Reverberance - Return
moves.description:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
While not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, use <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.

moves.name: Unraveling - Law Zero
moves.description:
Grant <color=Highlight>Resonant Thread of Closure</color> to all nearby Resonators in the team for {0}s.
While in <color=Highlight>Resonant Thread of Closure</color>:
- When an attack hits, increase the max stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850180>Negative Status</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> the target can receive by {1} for {2}s. Unstackable.
- Inflicting <color=Highlight><te href=850180>Negative Status</te></color> or dealing <color=Highlight><te href=150811>Negative Status DMG</te></color> grants <color=Highlight><te href=150802>Thread of Bane</te></color> for {3}s.

moves.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Sight of Unraveling - Oblivion
moves.description:
<color=Title>Unseen Snare</color>
Chisa inflicts <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> on the target for {0}s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting <color=Highlight>Serrated Loop</color>.
- Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Locking</color> on to a target.
When targets marked by <color=Highlight>Unseen Snare</color> take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts {1} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every {2}s.

<color=Title>Thread of Bane</color>
When dealing damage to targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>, ignore {4} of their DEF.

<color=Title>Chainsaw Mode</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa unlocks <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> consume <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> on hit.

<color=Title>Sawring - Blitz</color>
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start the combo from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, successful Dodges can be triggered.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>.
Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to sustain the attack. When <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> ends, cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> automatically.
Release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> automatically.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> deals <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Sawring - Eradication</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa casts <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> in the following 2 ways:
- Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
- Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after consuming all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> or <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
Attacking targets with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for {5}s.
The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Every {6} point of <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> consumed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>. Up to {7} points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> and ends <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.

<color=Title>Chainsaw Fever</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color>.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color> and exits <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa resets <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>.
When in <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color>.

<color=Title>Lifethread - Glide</color>
When Chisa is not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and has more than {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>, she can consume {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> in the following 5 ways:
- Press <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> in mid-air before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
- While in mid-air, press <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> or <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> forward shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
- Press <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing when launched into mid-air.
- Press <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>.
During the skill, hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.

<color=Title>Ring of Chainsaw</color>
Chisa can hold up to {9} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Normal Attack </color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> grants <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> grants {11} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.

<color=Title>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>
Chisa can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>.
Chisa continuously obtains <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> over time.
Chisa obtains {13} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> upon defeating a target.
Exiting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> resets <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> passively for a short period of time after casting <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.

values.name: Bonus DMG Multiplier per Ring of Chainsaw
Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter Hold DMG

moves.name: Inescapable Fate
moves.description: When a Resonator in the team defeats a target marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>, the Cooldown of Chisa's Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> is reset, triggered up to once every {0}s.

moves.name: All Ends Here
moves.description:
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> grants {0} Havoc DMG Bonus and {1} Healing Bonus for {2}s.
When Resonators in the team with <color=Highlight><te href=150802>Thread of Bane</te></color> defeat a target marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>, Chisa gains Sight of Unraveling, lasting {3}s.
While in Sight of Unraveling, Chisa inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color> that lasts for {4}s on the targets damaged by Resonators in the team with <color=Highlight><te href=150802>Thread of Bane</te></color>.

moves.name: POW POW
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Chixia fires up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Chixia enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Chixia consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

moves.name: Whizzing Fight Spirit
moves.description:
Chixia unleashes a flurry of shots, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=Highlight>Whizzing Fight Spirit</color> has 2 initial charges.

moves.name: Blazing Flames
moves.description: Chixia fires up fast shots at nearby enemies, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

moves.name: Scorching Magazine
moves.description: Max <te href=850041>Thermobaric Bullets</te> is increased by {0} rounds. The damage of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Boom Boom</color> is increased by {1}.

moves.name: Tune Break: Pistols
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Numbingly Spicy!
moves.description: Each <te href=850041>Thermobaric Bullet</te> that hits a target during Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>DAKA DAKA!</color> increases ATK by {0} for {1}s, stacking up to {2} times.

moves.name: Grand Entrance
moves.description: Chixia makes a heroic entrance and fires rapidly with her dual pistols at the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

moves.name: Heroic Bullets
moves.description:
<color=Title>Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!</color>
Hold Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Whizzing Fight Spirit</color> to enter <color=Highlight>DAKA DAKA!</color>. In this state:
- Chixia continuously consumes "Thermobaric Bullets" to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- Tap <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Then she exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- If {0} "Thermobaric Bullets" have been fired when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is activated, Chixia will cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Boom Boom</color> and exit "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- Chixia exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state when all "Thermobaric Bullets" are consumed.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill: Boom Boom</color>
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

<color=Title>Thermobaric Bullets</color>
Chixia can hold up to {1} "Thermobaric Bullets".
Inherent Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Magazine</color> increases Max "Thermobaric Bullets" by {2}.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" for every Normal Attack <color=Highlight>POW POW</color> on hit.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Grand Entrance</color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Whizzing Fight Spirit</color>.

moves.name: Leaping Flames
moves.description: Chixia releases a shock wave surrounding the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> equal to {0} of Chixia's ATK to enemies within the range.

moves.name: Quadruple Time Steps
moves.description:
<color=Title> Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> upon the target hit.
- When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, press Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.
- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color> is generated.

<color=Title>Solo Concert</color>
When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

<color=Title>Ensemble Sylph</color>
Up to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> is interrupted, the <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylphs</color> generated will continue the <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> for Ciaccona.
Aside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Aimed Attack</color>
Press Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Press Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Follow up successful <color=Highlight>Dodges</color> with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Harmonic Allegro
moves.description:
Move a certain distance, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and inflicting 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the target upon hit.
Press Normal Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
- When Ciaccona interrupts Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, or <color=Highlight><te href=850060>Solo Concert</te></color> with Resonance Skill, an <color=Highlight><te href=850059>Ensemble Sylph</te></color> is generated.
- Ciaccona's Resonance Skill can be cast in mid-air.

moves.name: Singer's Triple Cadenza
moves.description:
Ciaccona and <color=Highlight><te href=850059>Ensemble Sylphs</te></color> perform an <color=Highlight>Improvised Symphonic Poem</color> together, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> once to the nearby targets and entering <color=Highlight>Recital</color>.

<color=Title>Recital</color>
When in Recital, sound waves will periodically radiate around Ciaccona. When the sound wave overlaps with the circle indicator, press the green or yellow buttons to generate <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> of the corresponding color and recover a certain amount of Concerto Energy.
During Recital:
- Switching to another Resonator doesn't end Recital, but automatically generates a <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> matching the color of the last generated Tonic before switching. A green <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> is generated by default if no interaction input is given before switching to another Resonator.
- Ciaccona is immune to interruptions and takes {0} less DMG.
- Exit Recital by pressing Resonance Liberation again or switching Ciaccona back onto the field.
- <color=Highlight><te href=850059>Ensemble Sylphs</te></color> can now directly grant Aero DMG Bonus provided by <color=Highlight><te href=850060>Solo Concert</te></color>.

<color=Title>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color>
Green Tonic: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets and inflict a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit.
Yellow Tonic: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets and inflict a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> on targets hit.

moves.name: Roaming with the Wind
moves.description:
Attack the target to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and inflict a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color>.
Follow up with Basic Attack in time to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

moves.name: Windcalling Tune
moves.description: <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG dealt to targets near the active Resonator is Amplified by {0} for {1}s.

moves.name: Tune Break: Pistols
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Symphony of Wind and Verse
moves.description:
<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat</color>
When there are 3 segments of Musical Essence, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat</color>.
Consume all Musical Essence to shoot <color=Highlight>Downbeat Notes</color> forward to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, pulling in the nearby targets and inflicting 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the target hit.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat</color> can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Title>Musical Essence</color>
Ciaccona can hold up to 3 segments of Musical Essence.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> recovers 1 segment of Musical Essence.

moves.name: Interlude Tune
moves.description: Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Singer's Triple Cadenza</color> grants Ciaccona a Shield equal to {0} of her Max HP for {1}s. Switching out Ciaccona removes the Shield.

moves.name: Winds of Rinascita
moves.description: Increase <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Quadruple Downbeat</color>'s DMG by {0}.

moves.name: Execution
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Danjin performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Danjin consumes STA to launch consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to launch an attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades</color>
After a successful Dodge Counter, Danjin can use Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crimson Fragment</color> to perform Resonance Skill: <color=Highlight>Crimson Erosion</color>.

moves.name: Crimson Fragment
moves.description:
When casting <color=Highlight>Crimson Fragment</color>, each attack consumes {0} of Danjin's max HP. When Danjin's HP is less than {1}, this no longer consumes HP.

<color=Title>Carmine Gleam</color>
Danjin attacks the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Crimson Erosion</color>
After <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> or Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Vindication</color>, use <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to perform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Crimson Erosion 2</color> hits a target, apply <color=Highlight>Incinerating Will</color> to it.

<color=Title>Incinerating Will</color>
Danjin's damage dealt to targets marked with <color=Highlight>Incinerating Will</color> is increased by {2}.

<color=Title>Sanguine Pulse</color>

moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Beyond Threshold
moves.description:
<color=Title>Threshold State</color>
By default, Galbrena is in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, and in this state, she accumulates <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.

<color=Title>Demon Hypostasis</color>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood, and Resonance Skill - Encroach are replaced with Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge, and Resonance Skill - Ravage, which consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, every point of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> increases the DMG of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color> by {0}, up to {1}, which is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
When <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> depletes or after staying in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> for over 50s, <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> ends automatically.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>, and Stage 4 & 5 DMG <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
Press Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>
Consume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 3 DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
Press Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 1</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 2</color>.
Press Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 2 & 3</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>
While in mid-air, press Normal Attack to consume STA to perform aerial attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack.
Press Normal Attack after the Plunging Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color>
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
Press Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 4</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color>
Dash forward and leap into the air. Flip backward upon hitting the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color> share a cooldown.

<color=Title>Hellstride</color>
Press Dodge on the ground while casting <color=Highlight>Galbrena's own skills</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> to deal a fixed amount of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from DMG buffs. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> can trigger successful Dodges. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> cannot be cast consecutively.
Casting this skill does not reset the attack cycles within a short period of time.

<color=Title>Burning Drive</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> increases Galbrena's resistance to interruptions and ATK by {2} for {3}s.

<color=Title>Afterflame</color>
Galbrena can hold up to 40 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, Galbrena recovers 8 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> when Resonators in the nearby team cast Echo Skill. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets when Galbrena exits <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
All <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.

<color=Title>Sinflame</color>
Galbrena can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, hitting an enemy with Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Resonance Skill - Encroach, and Intro Skill - Hellflare Overload recovers <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.

moves.name: Oathbound Hunt
moves.description:
1 stack of <color=Highlight>Fated End</color> is inflicted on the target when the following skills hit: <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Volley of Death</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, up to {1} stacks. Each stack Amplifies the DMG directly dealt by Galbrena's <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, and <color=Highlight>Outro Skill</color> by {0} for {2}s. The same type of skill can trigger this effect on the same target once every {3}s.
<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> are considered the same type of skill.

moves.name: Sin Feaster
moves.description: Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 3</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 3</color> recovers {0} points of STA.

moves.name: Flaming Sakura Blade Art
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack - Present Self</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> reaches 300 points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color> becomes available.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> is consumed and <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available. The arrow applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Present Self</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Present Self</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5</color> each applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>
In <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Hold Breath</color>, continuously consuming STA. When <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the <color=Highlight>Hold Breath</color> state and thrusts forward, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2</color>.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4</color> instead.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume STA and 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> to gain 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>.
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3</color> apply <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
The <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> within a short period.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Frostblight
moves.description:
<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color>
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Casting this skill enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
Press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.

While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>:

<color=Title>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>
While on the ground, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, removing the targets' <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color>.
This skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.

<color=Title>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>
While in mid-air, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, removing the targets' <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color>.
This skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>.

moves.name: Foreclaiming
moves.description:
<color=Title>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>
<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, remove 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>. Then, enter <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> and restore 50 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> applies 4 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit.
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.

<color=Title>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> can be cast via the following ways:
- Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> and release to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If Hiyuki has 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>. Otherwise, this cast does not consume <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> periodically. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If no <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> is consumed when <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> will also be cast automatically when <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> depletes.
Hiyuki deals <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Each point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, and ends <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>.

moves.name: Frostedge
moves.description:
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and apply <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
In <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, casting this skill restores 200 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. Press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.
In <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2</color>.

moves.name: Snowlight Blessing
moves.description: Glacio DMG dealt by nearby Resonators other than Hiyuki in the team is Amplified by {0} against targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> for {1}s.

moves.name: Tune Break: Sword
moves.description:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Hiyuki can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

While in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Everfrost Dominion
moves.description:
<color=Title>Glacio Bite</color>
- While Hiyuki is in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>. Every time a new stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is inflicted on a target, an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is triggered based on that enemy's current <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stack limit. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> can be inflicted on <color=Highlight>frozen</color> targets. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te> DMG</color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> hits a target, if the target has no fewer than {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, consume {1} stacks and trigger <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color> once.
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> into <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, all enemies' <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stacks are cleared.

<color=Title>Present Self</color>
Hiyuki starts in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, casting certain skills restores <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.

<color=Title>Foreclaimed Self</color>
Hiyuki enters <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> after casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> through certain attacks.

<color=Title>Iai Stance</color>
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>:
- Press <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after casting any <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a certain period after casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>.
Hiyuki may enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> while airborne. Upon entering the <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Iai</color>
Within a certain period after entering <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> is cast, if Hiyuki has <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> to inflict 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit, and gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.

<color=Title>Dedication</color>
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color> restores 200 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now additionally restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

<color=Title>Frostheart</color>
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> is restored while casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> hits the target.

<color=Title>Frostharden Iai</color>
<color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> grants 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.

<color=Title>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color>
<color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> is consumed through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.

<color=Title>Snowforged Blade</color>
<color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> is cast, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.

moves.name: Fine Snow
moves.description:
When a Resonator in the team applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>. <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color> stacks up to {0} times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is Amplified by {1} against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by {2}.
2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, she additionally deals an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> with a fixed DMG Multiplier of {3}.
3 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is additionally Amplified by {4} against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

moves.name: Ephemeral Realm
moves.description: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, restore 1 point.

moves.name: Moon Steps
moves.description:
<color=Title>Moonring - Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Moonring - Dodge Counter</color>
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Press Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3.

<color=Title>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color>
Enter <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te> - New Moon</color> by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color>. When in this state, Iuno will attack with <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
When in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, press Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonbow - Basic Attack Stage 3.
Can be cast in mid-air.

moves.name: Foresight Fugue
moves.description:
<color=Title>Pulse of Origins</color>
Dash forward, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Closing Refrain</color>
When not in <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te></color>, casting <color=Highlight>Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, or <color=Highlight>Pulse of Origins</color> replaces Iuno's Resonance Skill with <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> for 5s.
Casting Closing Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, and activates <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.

<color=Title>Unfinished Refrain</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color>.
Casting Unfinished Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Unfinished Refrain shares the same Cooldown as Closing Refrain.

<color=Title>Arc Beyond the Edge</color>
When Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, her Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, which has 2 initial charges.
Casting Arc Beyond the Edge causes Iuno to shift position and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Directional input can be used to extend the travel distance. If Iuno is hit or launched into mid-air, casting <color=Highlight>Arc Beyond the Edge</color> immediately makes her recover from the attack.
Can be cast in mid-air.

moves.name: Beneath Lunar Tides
moves.description:
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and activate the <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te></color> state.
Can be cast in mid-air.

moves.name: Illuminated Manifestation
moves.description: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: From Gloom to Gleam
moves.description:
Attack the target to deal {0} <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. The incoming Resonator gains {1} Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for {2}s. This effect ends early if they are switched off the field.
Casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill</color> won't interrupt <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color>, and the Outro Skill effect still applies.

moves.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Ebb and Flow
moves.description:
<color=Title>Lunar Cycle</color>
Iuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.
Lunar Cycle has two states: <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> and <color=Highlight>New Moon</color>. By default, Iuno enters the <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>.
When in Lunar Cycle:
- Iuno's Jump is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air.
- Iuno's movement becomes <color=Highlight>Meandering</color>, which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.
- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.

<color=Title>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>
Iuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring <color=Highlight><te href=141003>Sentience</te></color> on hit.
She can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>
Iuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, or <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.
Iuno can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color>
When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.
Casting Absolute Fullness ends <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a <color=Highlight>Full Moon</color> domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Full Moon Domain</color>
Resonators inside the domain periodically restore HP and STA.
Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

<color=Title>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>
The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.

<color=Title>Sentience</color>
Iuno can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Intro Skill restores 40 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color> restores 25 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
When Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> on hit.
