moves.description: Every time Iuno casts Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, or Intro Skill, she gains {0} Shield equal to {1} of her ATK for {2}s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

moves.name: Derivation
moves.description: When Iuno casts Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation, she immediately gains {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=141002>Blessing of the Wan Light</te></color>.

moves.name: Fengyiquan
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Jianxin performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Jianxin consumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Jianxin consumes STA to plunge and unleash a powerful kick, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Calming Air
moves.description:
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>.

<color=Title>Chi Counter</color>
When Jianxin is attacked in the <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>, she does not take damage and immediately performs <color=Highlight>Chi Counter</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Chi Parry</color>
Release the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button during <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> to interrupt <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Chi Parry</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Purification Force Field
moves.description: Create a strong wind field, continuously pulling targets within the wind field to the center and dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. When the wind field disappears, it will trigger an explosion to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to all targets within the range again.

moves.name: Formless Release
moves.description: Damage of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Purification Force Field</color> is increased by {0}.

moves.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Reflection
moves.description: The Shield obtained from Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Primordial Chi Spiral</color> is increased by {0}.

moves.name: Essence of Tao
moves.description: Pull in targets within the range, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Transcendence
moves.description: The incoming Resonator has their Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by {0} for {1}s or until they are switched out.

moves.name: Primordial Chi Spiral
moves.description:
<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral</color>
When "Chi" reaches max stacks, hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Primordial Chi Spiral</color> and start <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color>.

<color=Title>Zhoutian Progress</color>
Jianxin's resistance to interruption is increased, and her the damage taken is reduced by {0}:
Jianxin continuously consumes "Chi" and casts <color=Highlight>Chi Strike</color> to attack targets nearby, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
As <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> accumulates, Jianxin reaches different Zhoutian and gains effects accordingly.
-Before Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 1 shield. When <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> is interrupted, cast <color=Highlight>Pushing Punch</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
-Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 2 shield and cast <color=Highlight>Shock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. When <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> is interrupted, cast <color=Highlight>Yielding Pull</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
-Major Zhoutian - Inner: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast <color=Highlight>Shock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. When <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> is interrupted, cast <color=Highlight>Yielding Pull</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
-Major Zhoutian - Outer: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast <color=Highlight>Shock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
-When <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> button is released, interrupt <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> and lose all "Chi";
-When all "Chi" is consumed, end <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color>.

When <color=Highlight>Zhoutian Progress</color> ends, regain a shield according to the Zhoutian Progress reached;
As the shield provided by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral</color> persists, the active character is healed once every {1}s.

<color=Title>Chi</color>
Jianxin can hold up to {2} Chi.
Chi is obtained when Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Fengyiquan</color> hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Calming Air</color> is cast.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skills <color=Highlight>Chi Counter</color> or <color=Highlight>Chi Parry</color> hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Essence of Tao</color> hits the target.

moves.name: Slash of Breaking Dawn
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Perform a charged attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to counterattack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Trailing Lights of Eons
moves.description:
Dash forward and perform consecutive strikes that inflict <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Overflowing Radiance</color>
After Jinhsi uses <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 4</color> or, while not in <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Loong's Halo</color>, an alternative Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overflowing Radiance</color> is available within {0}s.
Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overflowing Radiance</color> inflicts <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and sends Jinhsi into <color=Highlight><te href=850001>Incarnation</te></color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

moves.name: Purge of Light
moves.description:
Unleash the power of invocation to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

moves.description: Jinhsi gains {0} Spectro DMG Bonus.

moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Converged Flash
moves.description: DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Loong's Halo</color> is increased by {0}.

moves.name: Loong's Halo
moves.description: Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Temporal Bender
moves.description: Summoning the power homologous with the Sentinel, Jinhsi may now gain <te href=850002>Incandescence</te> via <color=Highlight>Eras in Unity</color> from damage of the same Attribute more effectively, at {1} time(s) every {0}s for {2}s.

moves.name: Luminal Synthesis
moves.description:
<color=Title>Incarnation</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color>:
- Alternative Basic Attack <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Basic Attack"</color> becomes available. Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> considered as Resonance Skill DMG. The basic attack cycle of this will not be reset. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>"Crescent Divinity"</color> becomes available. Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"</color> becomes available. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- Alternative Dodge <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Dodge"</color> is available while in mid-air. Can be cast multiple times at the cost of Stamina.
- Alternative Dodge Counter <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Dodge Counter"</color> becomes available. Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany</color>
After Stage 4 of <color=Highlight>Incarnation - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Incarnation</color> terminates and Jinhsi gains <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
While <color=Highlight>Ordination Glow</color> lasts:
- Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>"Incarnation - Heavy Attack"</color>. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>"Illuminous Epiphany"</color>. Send out <color=Highlight>Solar Flare</color> that detonates as <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> after a short delay. Consume up to {0} Incandescence, with each point of Incandescence granting bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to <color=Highlight>Stella Glamor</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
- After casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Illuminous Epiphany</color>, Jinhsi gains <color=Highlight>Unison</color>. This can be triggered once every {1}s.

<color=Title>Unison</color>
While Jinhsi has <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's <color=Highlight>Unison</color> to trigger Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. <color=Highlight>Unison</color> will be consumed in priority in place of Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full.

<color=Title>Incandescence</color>
Jinhsi can hold up to {2} Incandescence.
When Jinhsi is in the party, all nearby Resonators in the party gain <color=Highlight>Eras in Unity</color>.
<color=Highlight>Eras in Unity</color> provides 2 independent effects:
Jinhsi gains {3} Incandescence anytime Resonators in the party inflict Attribute DMG. This effect may be triggered by damage of the same Attribute for up to {5} time(s) every {4}s. Additionally, Jinhsi gains {6} Incandescence when Resonators in the party damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. This effect may be triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to {8} time(s) every {7}s.

moves.name: Lone Lance
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume Stamina to thrust forward, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Windborne Strike</color>
Hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Windborne Strike</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> ends, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Abyssal Slash</color>

<color=Title>Mid-Air Attack</color>
Consume Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
After performing the <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color>, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform a follow-up attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-Air Attack: Banner of Triumph</color>
After casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Windborne Strike</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color> in mid-air, Jiyan can perform a mid-air attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>

<color=Title>Qingloong Mode</color>

moves.name: Discipline

moves.name: Qingloong at War
moves.description:
When casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color>, if Jiyan has {0} or more "Resolve", he consumes {1} "Resolve" to increase the DMG of this Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color> by {2}.
When Jiyan is in <color=Highlight><te href=850031>Qingloong Mode</te></color>, DMG of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Windqueller</color> is increased by {3} and no longer consumes "Resolve".

<color=Title>Resonance Liberation: Emerald Storm - Finale</color>
When casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Emerald Storm - Prelude</color>, if Jiyan has {4} "Resolve" or more, he will consume {5} "Resolve" to cast Emerald Storm - Finale, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Emerald Storm: Finale can be cast in mid-air at low altitude.

<color=Title>Resolve</color>
Jiyan can hold up to {6} Resolve.
Jiyan gains "Resolve" when his Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Lone Lance</color> hits the target.
Jiyan gains "Resolve" when the Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Tactical Strike</color> hits the target.

moves.name: Tempest Taming

Lingyang performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Basic Attack: Feral Roars</color>
After Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color> is cast, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack 5</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Feral Roars</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Lingyang consumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>

moves.description:
<color=Title>Ancient Arts</color>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Furious Punches</color>

moves.name: Unification of Spirits
moves.description:
<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge</color>
When "Lion's Spirit" is full, use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike</color>
When "Lion's Spirit" is not full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Striding Lion</color>
After casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state;
After casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Lion Awakens</color> or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color>, if "Lion's Spirit" is full, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state.
In the <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state:
-Attacks can be launched in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Glorious Plunge</color> to get back in the air.
-"Lion's Spirit" is continuously consumed before running out in {0}s, and when it runs out, <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> ends;
-If Lingyang is in the Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Lion's Vigor</color> state, the consumption speed of "Lion's Spirit" is reduced by {1}, extending <color=Highlight>Striding Lion</color> state by up to {2}s.
-Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Feral Gyrate</color>, which performs up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>;
-Lingyang's <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Mountain Roamer</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>;
-When "Lion's Spirit" is less than {3}, use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>; after performing Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Stormy Kicks</color>, the Mid-air Attack <color=Highlight>Tail Strike</color> becomes available.
-Concerto Energy is restored when "Lion's Spirit" is consumed.

<color=Title>Lion's Spirit</color>
Lingyang can hold up to {4} "Lion's Spirit".
When casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Furious Punches</color>, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Lion Awakens</color>, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Strive: Lion's Vigor</color>, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.

moves.name: Snapshot
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to deploy <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>. A cursor will move around the <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button when the cursor falls outside of <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will trigger <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button when the cursor falls within <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will trigger <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>, dealing increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring additional <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
Pressing <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color> will trigger <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color> instead of deploying <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color> is deployed, the <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> zone continues to fill the ring. Once <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color> is completely filled, it automatically collapses and triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, and 3</color> in sequence, and deploy <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color> during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Shortly after performing this attack, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Phantom Frame
moves.description:
Pull in nearby targets, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
While casting this skill, hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deploy <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>. A cursor will move around the <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button when the cursor falls outside of <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will trigger <color=Highlight>Compensate</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
- Releasing the <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button when the cursor falls within <color=Highlight>Perfect Focus</color> will trigger <color=Highlight>Spotlight</color>, dealing increased <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring additional <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color>.
If Lucilla casts the skill on-field without holding <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>, she directly casts <color=Highlight>Compensate</color> instead of deploying <color=Highlight>Focus Ring</color>.

<color=Title>Compensate</color>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and reducing the Cooldown of Lucilla's <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> by {0}s.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Spotlight</color>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Spotlight</color>, Lucilla additionally restores {1} points of Concerto Energy, and inflicts {2} extra stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> onto the target if she is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>.
<color=Highlight>Spotlight</color> is immune to interruptions. Switching to another Resonator while casting <color=Highlight>Spotlight</color> ends the skill early.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

moves.name: Clear As Day
moves.description:
Lucilla holds up to 0 Resonance Energy. <color=Highlight>Clear As Day</color> consumes no Resonance Energy.
<color=Highlight>Clear As Day</color> unlocks when Lucilla holds all 3 <color=Highlight><te href=110902>Photos</te></color>.

<color=Title>Clear As Day</color>
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Reminiscence</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, the DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. Casting this skill grants Lucilla {0} Basic Attack DMG Bonus for {1}s.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, the DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>. Casting this skill grants Lucilla {0} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {1}s.
When in <color=Highlight>Reminiscence</color>, Lucilla's resistance to interruption is increased, and she cannot cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Reminiscence</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut</color> respectively.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms</color>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 1, 2, & 3</color> consecutively.
While casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>, consecutively press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target.
While casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or finish the whole <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color> to automatically perform <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color>.

<color=Title>Letting It Go</color>
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> to targets within the range. When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, DMG dealt is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>/<color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
Lucilla is immune to interruption and damage during <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color>, and Resonator switching is disabled while casting.
While casting <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color>, Lucilla additionally restores {2} points of Concerto Energy.
Casting <color=Highlight>Letting It Go</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=110905>Reminiscence</te></color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Reminiscence</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Memory Palace
moves.description:
<color=Title>Déjà Vu</color>
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day</color>, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, gain {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110903>Film Roll</te></color> for {1}s, stacking up to {2} times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, gain {6} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110904>Zoom</te></color> for {7}s. Max {8} stack, which is removed when the duration ends.
The above effects end early when Lucilla switches Resonance Mode.

<color=Title>Film Roll</color>
When an active Resonator in the team other than Lucilla inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> onto the target, Lucilla consumes {3} stacks of <color=Highlight>Film Roll</color> to inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> {4} times on nearby targets. This effect can be triggered once every {5}s.

<color=Title>Zoom</color>
Each stack of <color=Highlight>Zoom</color> increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by {9}.

<color=Title>Oblivion</color>
During <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3</color>, Lucilla consumes 1 <color=Highlight><te href=110902>Photo</te></color> intermittently to perform <color=Highlight>Oblivion</color>, dealing 1 instance of <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, this instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. The skill inflicts {11} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on the target.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, this instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>. Each cast of <color=Highlight>Oblivion</color> is considered as casting a different Echo Skill.

<color=Title>Quick Glance</color>
Press Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, environmental collectibles, and special collectibles within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. Press the shutter button to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.

<color=Title>Trace</color>
Lucilla can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Trace</color>.
Restore {13} points of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Clip It</color>.
Restore {14} points of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Spotlight</color>.
Restore {14} points of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable</color>.
Restore {15} points of <color=Highlight>Trace</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Compensate</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable</color>.

<color=Title>Photos</color>
Lucilla can hold up to {16} <color=Highlight>Photos</color>.
Every {17} points of <color=Highlight><te href=110901>Trace</te></color> restored generates 1 <color=Highlight>Photo</color>.

moves.name: Slow Motion
moves.description:

While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Spotlight</color>, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>, Glacio RES of targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is reduced by {0} for {1}s. If an enemy falls to <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> DMG during this time, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, Resonators in the team gain {2} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {3}s.
These enhancements end when Lucilla switches the Resonance Mode.

moves.name: Remembrance
moves.description:
<color=Highlight><te href=110903>Film Roll</te></color> can now be stacked up to {0} stacks, and <color=Highlight><te href=110904>Zoom</te></color> up to {1} stacks.
Each time Lucilla consumes <color=Highlight><te href=110902>Photo</te></color> when in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Echo</color>, she gains {2} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110903>Film Roll</te></color>/{3} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110904>Zoom</te></color>.

moves.name: Locked Thread
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to {0} consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {1}</color> to continuously attack the targets, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {2}</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {3}</color> lands to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {4}</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {5}</color> lands to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {6}</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {7}</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {8}</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {9}</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {10}</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after this skill lands to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {11}</color>.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, Lucy's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>.
Perform up to {12} consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, Lucy's <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>.
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {13}</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=151105>Root Access</te></color> reaches {14} points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>.
Consume STA and all <color=Highlight><te href=151105>Root Access</te></color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {15}</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflicting <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> on the target. <color=Highlight><te href=151106>SQL</te></color> can be consumed for a {16}% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {17}</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, Mid-air Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction</color>.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {18}</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {19}</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Payload</color>
Cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> to charge forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflicting <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and activating <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by {0}%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after the follow-up attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {1}</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {2}</color>.

Cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> to cut through the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting <color=Highlight>Digital Handshake</color>.
<color=Highlight>Digital Handshake</color>: When Lucy is not in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color> every second. This effect is removed when <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color> reaches {3} points or when <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is cast.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {4}</color>.

moves.name: Netrunner
moves.description:
<color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for {0}s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to {1} different <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with {2} points of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> is held down, <color=Highlight>Override</color> is triggered, which deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any <color=Highlight>Spoofing Programs</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to trigger <color=Highlight>Override</color> on all marked targets.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Ping</color>
Requires {3} RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>
Requires {4} RAM. Marked targets take {5}% more DMG for {6}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>
Requires {7} RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by {8}% for {9}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout</color>
Requires {10} RAM. Deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>
Requires {11} RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by {12}% for {13}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>
Requires {14} RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by {15}% within {16}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>
Requires {17} RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

<color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is cast, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>. Lucy gains all effects of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>, and the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Override</color> is greatly increased.
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, or when Lucy exits the <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

values.name: Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive: Override DMG

moves.name: Outdated Hallucination
moves.description:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and granting Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>Involuntary Sharing</color>, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for {0}s. Additionally, <color=Highlight>Involuntary Sharing</color> is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for {1}s.
If Lucy is not in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> after casting this skill, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {2}</color>.
If Lucy is in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> after casting this skill, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {3}</color>.
After casting this skill, the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> additionally grants {4} points of <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color>.

moves.name: Countermeasure Program
moves.description:
The incoming Resonator gains {0}% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for {1}s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> for {2}s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>, that Resonator gains {3}% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them {5}% DMG Reduction for {4}s and Stagnates their attacker for {6}s. This effect can only trigger up to {7} time while <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> is active. Obtaining <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> again resets the effective charge.
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> early.

moves.name: Data Crash
moves.description:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Lucy can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.
Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>: when Resonators in the team trigger <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target and cause them to be affected by <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>, Lucy applies <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color> on the target. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to {1} times every {0}s.

moves.name: Depths of Blackwall
moves.description:
<color=Title>Cloud Portal</color>
When not in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> upon hitting a target. At {0} points of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> clears all <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.

<color=Title>Algorithm Compaction</color>
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>, Lucy enters <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> and gains {1} stacks of <color=Highlight>SQL</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Lucy's <color=Light>Spectro DMG Bonus</color> is increased by {2}% for {3}s.
While in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> again will not grant <color=Highlight>SQL</color> and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> upon hitting a target with attacks including <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Reaching {4} points of <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> replaces <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>. Press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy has <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by {5}% and remove <color=Highlight>SQL</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy does not have <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, she loses {6}% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below {7}%, no HP is consumed.
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>.
Lucy exits the the <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> state after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is not followed up by one of these skills: <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Locked Thread</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color>, and <color=Highlight>Tune Break - Data Crash</color>.

<color=Title>Hack Response - Data Crash</color>
Lucy deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> and applies the same target with <color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>, considered Hack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for {9}s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

<color=Title>TCP</color>
Lucy holds up to {10} points of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>.
After casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color>, casting the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> additionally grants {11} points of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.

<color=Title>Root Access</color>
Lucy holds up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Root Access</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction</color>.

moves.name: Ghost Cyberware
moves.description:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for {0}s, she gains {1} stacks of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>. Max {2} stacks by default.
<color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by {3}%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove {4} stacks of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>. This effect can be triggered up to {6} times every {5}s.

moves.name: Function Cracking
moves.description:
When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> damages an <color=Highlight>Overlord Class</color> or <color=Highlight>Calamity Class</color> enemy, Lucy applies <color=Highlight>Botnet Mark</color> on them for {0} min. While <color=Highlight>Botnet Mark</color> is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color> effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

<color=Title>Network Backdoor</color>
Grants {1}% All DMG Amplification and {2}% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for {3} min and stacks up to {4} times. At {5} stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by {6}% and Hack DMG Multiplier by {7}%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color>, and any existing <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color> effects become invalid.

moves.name: Navigation Support
moves.description:
<color=Title>Yellow Light: Basic Attack</color>
Summon Squeakie to shoot three shots in a row, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Yellow Light: Sprint</color>
Dodge to perform <color=Highlight>Sprint</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Zoom Mode</color>. Lumi is unable to Dodge when performing <color=Highlight>Sprint</color>.

<color=Title>Yellow Light: Zoom</color>
When in this state, automatically shoot <color=Highlight>Glitters</color> at a locked-on target and deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Yellow Light: Plunging Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Red Light: Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Red Light: Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to strike the ground with Squeakie, causing an impact dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Red Light: Plunging Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Red Light: Dodge Counter</color>
Use Basic Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

values.name: Yellow Light: Plunging Attack STA Cost
Red Light: Heavy Attack STA Cost
Red Light: Plunging Attack STA Cost

moves.name: Searchlight Service
moves.description:
<color=Title>Pounce</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Pounce, which consumes STA to pounce on the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>.
Lumi will perform a <color=Highlight>Pounce</color> without STA cost when switched onto the field.

<color=Title>Rebound</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Rebound, which consumes STA to leap backward and attack the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>.

<color=Title>Yellow Light Mode</color>
Perform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.

<color=Title>Red Light Mode</color>
Perform melee attacks when in Red Light Mode.

moves.name: Squeakie Express
moves.description: Throw the giant Squeakie at the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Special Delivery
moves.description: Enter <color=Highlight><te href=850043>Yellow Light Mode</te></color> and attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Escorting
moves.description: The incoming Resonator has their Resonance Skill DMG Amplified by {0} for {1}s or until they are switched out.

moves.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Signal Light
moves.description:
<color=Title>Energized Pounce</color>
When Yellow Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Pounce</color> that deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
When in <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Red Light: Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Red Light: Heavy Attack</color> is increased, with an extra amount of Sparks recovered.
<color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color> ends after performing altogether 4 Basic Attacks and/or Heavy Attacks.

<color=Title>Energized Rebound</color>
When Red Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> that deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
When in <color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Glitter</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Glare</color>, with an increased DMG Multiplier and an extra amount of Sparks recovered.
<color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color> ends after shooting 6 <color=Highlight>Glares</color>.

<color=Title>Laser</color>
Casting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks obtained in the current mode.
Laser can be cast when the amount of consumed Sparks is greater than or equal to {0}, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Every {0} Sparks consumed generates {1} extra Laser beam, up to {2} Laser beams.

<color=Title>Yellow Light Spark</color>
Lumi can hold up to {3} Yellow Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Yellow Light Spark under the following conditions:
When <color=Highlight>Yellow Light: Basic Attack</color> hits the target;
When <color=Highlight>Glitter</color> hits the target;
When <color=Highlight>Glare</color> hits the target;
When Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> hits the target;
When casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Special Delivery</color>.

<color=Title>Red Light Spark</color>
Lumi can hold up to {3} Red Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Red Light Spark under the following conditions:
When Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Navigation Support</color> hits the target in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>.

moves.name: Pathfinding
moves.description: Gain {0} Electro DMG Bonus when in <te href=850044>Red Light Mode</te>.

moves.name: Expediting
moves.description: Casting <color=Highlight>Energized Pounce</color> or <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> increases ATK by {1} for {0}s.

moves.name: Flaming Star
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- After Basic Attack Stage 3, press Normal Attack in the right time to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color>.
- After <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Starfall</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color>, or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>, press Normal Attack in time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>
When <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {0} points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Wolf's Gnawing</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {1} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain {2} points of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>
When <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {3} points and <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {4} point, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Wolf's Claw</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- If <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {5} points and <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {6} point after performing <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in time to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>.
- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {7} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain {8} points of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform up to 3 attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. The <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle will not be reset.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>
When <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {9} points, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Heavy Attack DMG).
- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {10} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain {11} points of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.

<color=Title>Plunging Attack</color>
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. After performing this attack, press Normal Attack in time to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Starfall</color>.
- If a <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> is performed while casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> in time at the cost of STA.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Starfall</color>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

values.name: Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing STA Cost
Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw STA Cost

moves.name: Shewolf's Hunt
moves.description:
Lupa hurls her Wildfire Banner at the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and restoring {0} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. <color=Highlight>Mark</color> the target for {1}s. After performing Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color>, Lupa can perform <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color> within a certain period of time.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
- Hold Resonance Skill to leap into the air, then press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in time to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Feral Fang</color>
Lupa locks onto a target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and restoring {2} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. The DMG Multiplier to <color=Highlight>marked</color> targets is increased by {3}. Resonance Skill - Feral Fang enters cooldown if not cast in time or when Lupa is switched out.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

moves.name: Fire-Kissed Glory
moves.description:
Attack the target and deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Performing this attack consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> and restores {0} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Use Basic Attack or Resonance Skill in time to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Foebreaker</color>.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
Performing this skill strengthens all Resonators in the team. Within {1}s:
- All Resonators in the team gain <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> effect.
- If the active Resonator is hit or launched into the air, they immediately recover and are considered to have successfully dodged the attack when they are on the ground. Can be triggered up to 3 times.

<color=Title>Pack Hunt</color>
Resonators with <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> gain a {2} ATK increase, and {3} Fusion DMG Bonus when they attack Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets (Both are non-stackable). If there are {7} Fusion Resonators in the team, the Fusion DMG Bonus against Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets additionally increases by {8}. When the active Resonator casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> is enhanced, granting an additional {4} ATK increase to all Resonators in the team, up to a maximum of {5}.
If Lupa's <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> reaches its cap within its duration, she enters <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> becomes available. <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> can be triggered once per <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Foebreaker</color>
Consume all <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform <color=Highlight>Foebreaker</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and entering <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> state.

<color=Title>Burning Matchpoint</color>
Normal Attacks restore {6} more <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> on hit. Cannot perform Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color> in this state.

moves.name: Try Focusing, Eh?
moves.description:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Try Focusing, Eh?</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Nowhere to Run!</color>
When Lupa enters the <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> state, her next Intro Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=850176>Pack Hunt</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=850178>Glory</te></color> effects on all Resonators in the team, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).

moves.name: Stand by Me, Warrior
moves.description: The incoming Resonator will have their Fusion DMG Amplified by {0} and Basic Attack DMG Amplified by {1} for {2}s or until the Resonator is switched out.

moves.name: Tune Break: Broadblade
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Ignis Lupa
moves.description:
<color=Title>Wildfire Banner</color>
Lupa's ATK is increased by {0} for {1}s when performing the following actions:
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> and <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf</color>
When <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {2} points, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>
When <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {3} points in the <color=Highlight><te href=850177>Burning Matchpoint</te></color> state, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG). <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> is removed when the skill ends.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze</color>
Within {4}s after performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> or <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>, Lupa will remain on the field after switching to another Resonator and back up the active Resonator when they perform <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG). This effect can only be triggered once in its duration.

<color=Title>Wolflame</color>
Lupa can hold up to {5} points of Wolflame.
- Restore Wolflame when Normal Attacks hit the target.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Skill.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Liberation.

<color=Title>Wolfaith</color>
Lupa can hold up to {6} points of Wolfaith.
Wolfaith lasts for {7}s. The duration is reset when Wolfaith is restored. At the end of its duration, each remaining point of Wolfaith becomes {8} points of Wolflame.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to jump into the air, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> Stage {0} and 3 in mid-air.
Luuk Herssen attacks with <color=Highlight>Scythe: Dissection</color> when the input is <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>.
Luuk Herssen attacks with <color=Highlight>Scythe: Resection</color> when the input is <color=Highlight>Jump</color>. He also inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for {1}s and reduces DMG taken by {3} for {2}s.
As the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.
While in mid-air, <color=Highlight>hold Normal Attack</color> to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.
<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Reunion of All the Fallen
moves.description:
<color=Title>Golden Reflux</color>
Flash toward the target and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for 25s.
<color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color> has 2 charges.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Aureole of Execution</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> replaces <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> with <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color>, which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for 25s.
<color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> has {0} forms, including <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Ring</color>, <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Breach</color>, and <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color>.
Casting any form of <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> grants {1} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=151001>Endnotes on the Endgame</te></color> and switches <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> to the next form in sequence.
Switching to another Resonator resets the cycle of <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is reset to <color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Ring</color>
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, and reset the <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle to Stage 1.
The next <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color> is no longer available if <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

<color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Breach</color>
Spin and dash forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to enemies along the path and resetting the <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an <color=Highlight><te href=151004>Ichor Blade</te></color>.
The next <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color> is no longer available if <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

<color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color>
Hurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and forming an <color=Highlight>Ichor Deposit</color> on the ground.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>
Flash toward the target and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Ichor Deposit</color>
<color=Highlight>Ichor Deposit</color> detonates automatically after {3}s, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Endnotes on the Endgame</color>
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> by {4}, stacking up to {2} times. Casting <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.

Luuk Herssen can respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.
When responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>: For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, each point of Luuk Herssen's Tune Break Boost increases his total DMG against the target by {1}. While Luuk Herssen is in the team, the max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on a target is increased by {2}.
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Luuk Herssen can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Spark from the Frost
moves.description:
<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color>
When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color> is hurled out, <color=Highlight>press Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color>.
Slam down from the air to detonate the <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.
<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> is no longer available when Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.

<color=Title>Aureate Judge</color>
With full <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te>, enter the <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:
- <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> increase by {15}.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> and <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color> DMG by {15}.
- {1} points of <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> is consumed each time Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> is cast.
- <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> ends when <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> depletes.

<color=Title>Golden Rule</color>
When Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen {3} points of <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> and {4} points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after {2}s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.

<color=Title>Dawnlit Keep</color>
Luuk Herssen gains {6} stacks of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over {5}s or casts Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Before Injection of Dawn</color>.
Dawnlit Keep is capped at {7} stack. When taking damage from enemies, consume {9} stacks of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by {14} and gain immunity to interruptions for {10}s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

<color=Title>Radiant Reave</color>
When Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an <color=Highlight><te href=151004>Ichor Blade</te></color>.
Luuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.
If Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, <color=Highlight>press Dodge</color> before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than {12}s, the trigger count is reset.

<color=Title>Ichor Blade</color>
Deal fixed <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.
Only one <color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> can exist at a time. It cannot trigger <color=Highlight>Counterattack</color>.
<color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> cannot be launched without a nearby target.
<color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.

<color=Title>Ichor Flow</color>
Luuk Herssen holds up to {0} points of Ichor Flow.
Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> restore Ichor Flow on hit.
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Before Injection of Dawn</color> restores {13} points of Ichor Flow.

- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.
- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> stacks.

<color=Title>Perpetuating Daytime</color>
- When Resonators in the team casts <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color>, if the target is affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color>, Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, up to the target's current <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> stack cap. Cooldown: {1}s.
Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime and will not be able to obtain any new stacks when knocked out.
- Perpetuating Daytime stacks up to {0} times.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

During this state, 15 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> will be converted to 12.5% of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> every 0.2s. Lynae is immune to interruption and takes {0} less DMG.

- Spark Collision Lv. 1: <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> <50%
- Spark Collision Lv. 2: 50% ≤ <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> < 100%
- Spark Collision Lv. 3: <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>=100%

Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
With 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 1 & 4</color> track enemies in a greater distance.

Consume STA to continuously attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG. Release to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast this skill. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Cannot gain new charges while in the air. The available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and is on the ground.

<color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack</color>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack</color>.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>.
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Casting this skill increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by {0} for {1}s.

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
