moves.description:
Attack the target and deal {0} <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. The next incoming Resonator gain {1} All DMG Amplification and {2} Resonance Liberation DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Lynae leaves the <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> state upon casting Outro Skill.

moves.name: Spectral Analysis
moves.description:
Lynae can inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets.
Lynae can respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.
- Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>: When any Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG and inflicts the <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> state, Lynae casts <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color>. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>: For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, each point of Lynae's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against that target by {1}. When Lynae is in the team, the target's max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> is increased by 1.
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Lynae can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Chromaticity Modeling
moves.description:
<color=Title>Optical Sampling Stage</color>
Lynae is in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color> by default. While in this state, <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> recovers during certain skills.

<color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> sends Lynae into <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster <color=Highlight>Free Skating</color> and <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color>.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, with at least 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, Jump is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>.
Consume 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> cast recovers 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
Within a certain time after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1</color> press Normal Attack on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2</color> also pulls in nearby targets.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> is on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and this skill is not on cooldown, press Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color> and grants all nearby Resonators in the team {0} points of Tune Break Boost for {1}s.
Press Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Mode</color>
Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> when hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!</color>.
Lynae can switch between <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.

<color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color>

moves.name: Critical Protocol

- Increases the DEF of all nearby Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>High Syntony Field</color> by {8}.
- Inherits the <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>'s boost to resistance to interruption and <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color>.
- Inherits the <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>'s healing effect and increases the Healing Multiplier by {7}.

moves.name: Convergence

moves.name: Decoupling

Mornye can respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.

Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every {0}s.
- Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>: Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target increases Mornye's total DMG against them. Each point of Mornye's <color=Highlight>Tune Break Boost</color> increases the total DMG by {1}. While Mornye is in the team, the max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on a target is increased by {2}.
Mornye can perform <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> against the targets with full <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color>.

moves.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
moves.description:
<color=Title>Baseline Mode</color>
While in her default <color=Highlight>Baseline Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color> to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> and enters <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>.

<color=Title>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>
<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> lasts for {11}s.
- Upon entering <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye generates a <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color>.
- If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> is below {0} when holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3</color> in sequence. If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} during this time, cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Dodging</color> with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, press <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to {12} times, which resets when <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- Press Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> are unavailable. If Jump is pressed when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. She will leave the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> also when she <color=Highlight>Dodges</color>, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.

<color=Title>Syntony Field</color>
- <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> lasts for {1}s.
- When the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> is generated, deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>, triggered once every {2}s.
- Increases the <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color> of all nearby Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> by {3}.
- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>
- When <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>.
- Consume all <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> upon the target on hit for {4}s.

<color=Title>Observation Marker</color>
When a Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight>Observation Marker</color>, Mornye inflicts an <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color> on the target for {5}s.

<color=Title>Interfered Marker</color>
Targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every {8} of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding {7}, their DMG is increased by {9}, up to {10}.

<color=Title>Visual Field</color>
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight>Visual Field</color> for {6}s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.

<color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet</color>
Mornye deals one instance of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets in the <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> state within range, considered <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Rest Mass Energy</color>
Mornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120901>Baseline Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color> when performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution</color> hits a target.

<color=Title>Relative Momentum</color>
Mornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color> hits the target.

- When Divine Voice is exhausted, Phoebe will not exit the <color=Highlight>Absolution</color> or <color=Highlight>Confession</color> status.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Starflash</color>
When Phoebe has Divine Voice, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> replaces the next <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack: Starflash</color>, which deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> at the cost of {2} Divine Voice.
- <color=Highlight>Absolution</color> Enhancement: Reduce the cost of Divine Voice by {3}. When the targets hit have <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color>, the skill gains {4} DMG Amplification.
- <color=Highlight>Confession</color> Enhancement: Apply {5} stacks of <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> to the targets hit.

<color=Title>Prayer </color>
Phoebe can hold up to {6} Prayer.
Phoebe automatically gains {7} Prayer every second.

<color=Title>Divine Voice</color>
Phoebe can hold up to {8} Divine Voice.
Casting Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Absolution Litany</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Utter Confession</color> restores {9} Divine Voice.

moves.name: Presence
moves.description: Mid-air Heavy Attack can be cast {0} more times.

moves.name: Revelation
moves.description: When in the <color=Highlight>Absolution</color> status and <color=Highlight>Confession</color> status, Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by {0}.

moves.name: Movement of Life and Death
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
When performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, enter <color=Highlight><te href=160805>Reincarnate</te></color> state.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Scarlet Coda</color>
Phrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state every {1}s.
When the following 3 conditions are met, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Scarlet Coda</color>.
- Has 6 <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color>.
- In the <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state.
- Not in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state.

<color=Highlight>Scarlet Coda</color>: Consume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling in nearby targets. This instance of damage is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=160803>Aftersound</te></color> additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.
Casting this skill is considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.
Casting this skill sends <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state into cooldown and activates the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Whispers in a Fleeting Dream
moves.description:
Attack the target and deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Casting this skill sends Phrolova into <color=Highlight><te href=160805>Reincarnate</te></color>.

moves.name: Waltz of Forsaken Depths
moves.description:
<color=Title>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color>
Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, and Phrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state for {0}s.

<color=Title>Maestro</color>
Gain {5} ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color> in turn. Each <color=Highlight>Volatile Note</color> holds for {1}s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Basic Attack</color>: Press Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every {2} times Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Dodge</color>: Press Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Reset</color>: Press Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Curtain Call</color>: Press Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> and end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to {4} times in total during Phrolova's <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect {3} times.
Switching back to Phrolova ends <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
Ending <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color>.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).

<color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and Stagnating the targets (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).

<color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).

<color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).

<color=Title>Curtain Call</color>
<color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, press Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, casting <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> and ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.

moves.name: Suite of Quietus
moves.description:
<color=Title>Suite of Quietus</color>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Suite of Immortality</color>
When in the <color=Highlight><te href=160804>Maestro</te></color> state, the next <color=Highlight>Suite of Quietus</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Suite of Immortality</color>. This replacement is cancelled if <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> is cast while in this state. <color=Highlight>Suite of Immortality</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>) and Stagnates the target.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Unfinished Piece
moves.description:
The incoming Resonator gains {0} Havoc DMG Amplification and {1} Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for {2}s or until they are switched out.
If Phrolova is in <color=Highlight><te href=160804>Maestro</te></color> state when she casts this skill, Hecate additionally casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> {3} times when Phrolova is switched off the field while in the same <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state duration.

moves.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Rhapsody of a New World
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack - Movement of Fate and Finality</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Movement of Fate and Finality</color>, which Stagnates the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>) and ending <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color> afterward.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Murmurs in a Haunting Dream</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color>, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Murmurs in a Haunting Dream</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>) and ending <color=Highlight>Reincarnate</color> afterward.

<color=Title>Aftersound</color>
Phrolova can hold up to {0} stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color>, <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color>, and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color> grants {1} stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is out of combat, all stacks of Aftersound are removed every {2}s.

<color=Title>Volatile Note</color>
Phrolova can hold up to 6 <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color>. When <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> reach the max number, gaining new <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> moves all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> one slot to the left, and the leftmost <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color> or <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color> will be removed.
Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Movement of Fate and Finality</color> grants 1 <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color>.
Hitting a target with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Whispers in a Fleeting Dream</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Murmurs in a Haunting Dream</color> grants 1 <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Inherent Skill - Accidental</color> is activated, casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, or Echo Skill grants 1 <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>.
Phrolova cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> during <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color>.

moves.name: Accidental
moves.description:
Casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color> grants increased resistance to interruption and reduces damage taken by {0} for {1}s.
After casting <color=Highlight>Suite of Quietus</color>, <color=Highlight>Suite of Immortality</color>, and <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>, the next <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Note</te></color> becomes <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>.

moves.name: Octet
moves.description:
Obtain {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=160803>Aftersound</te></color> upon entering battle. This effect cannot be triggered again within {1}s after exiting the combat state. For every {2} stacks of <color=Highlight>Aftersound</color>, Crit. DMG is increased by {3}.
When <color=Highlight>Aftersound</color> reaches the max, each new stack of <color=Highlight>Aftersound</color> increases Phrolova's Crit. DMG by {4}, up to {5}. The increased Crit. DMG is removed when <color=Highlight>Aftersound</color> stacks are cleared.

moves.name: Strings to Steel
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack - Stringblade</color>
Press repeatedly or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4</color> are in <color=Highlight>Sheathed Stance</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color> are in <color=Highlight>Drawn Stance</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=141301>Qin Heart</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=141302>Sword Cadence</te></color> are full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color> becomes available.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=141301>Qin Heart</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=141302>Sword Cadence</te></color> and sends Qingxiao into the <color=Highlight><te href=141303>Ephemeral Transcendence</te></color> state.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
This skill is in <color=Highlight>Drawn Stance</color>.
After landing from <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color>, press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color>.
While in mid-air, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Plunging Attack</color>
While in the <color=Highlight><te href=141306>Sword Flight</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Jump</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color>.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
While out of the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Stringblade</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
This skill is in <color=Highlight>Drawn Stance</color>.
Press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4</color>.

<color=Title>Sword Glide</color>
While in mid-air, <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Sword Glide</color>.

moves.name: Severing Note
moves.description:
<color=Title>Severing Note: Judgement</color>
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. During this skill, gain {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=141301>Qin Heart</te></color>.
While not in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state, press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4</color>.

<color=Title>Severing Note: Ascendant</color>
While casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Stringblade</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Severing Note: Ascendant</color>.
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
This skill is in <color=Highlight>Drawn Stance</color>.

moves.name: Billows Beneath Heaven
moves.description:
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

moves.name: Tonality Shift
moves.description:
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Casting the skill restores {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=141302>Sword Cadence</te></color> and grants <color=Highlight><te href=141305>Resonant Chime</te></color>.

<color=Title>Resonant Chime</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement</color> grants {1} points of <color=Highlight><te href=141301>Qin Heart</te></color> and removes <color=Highlight>Resonant Chime</color>.

moves.name: Lingering Song
moves.description: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> equal to {0} of Qingxiao's ATK.

moves.name: Draw and Sunder
moves.description:
Qingxiao inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target after dealing damage with skills. Each skill can only trigger this once for the same target.
Qingxiao can respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.
Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>: For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, every point of Qingxiao's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG Qingxiao deals to that target by {0}. While Qingxiao is in the team, the max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on a target is increased by {1}.
Additionally, when the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Qingxiao can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on it. While on the ground and not in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color>.

moves.name: Formless Heart Sword
moves.description:
<color=Title>Ephemeral Transcendence</color>
While Qingxiao is in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> become available.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>
Press repeatedly or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Before <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>
Press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Before <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=141307>Heart Sword Intent</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> becomes available. Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=141307>Heart Sword Intent</te></color> and ends the <color=Highlight><te href=141303>Ephemeral Transcendence</te></color> state.

<color=Title>Mindlock</color>
<color=Highlight>Mindlock</color> stacks up to {1} times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on a target, inflict {2} stacks of <color=Highlight>Mindlock</color> on the target.
For each stack of <color=Highlight>Mindlock</color> on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by {3}, with an additional {5} per stack for the first {4} stacks.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven</color>.

<color=Title>Heaven's Clarity</color>
Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Billows Beneath Heaven</color>, gain <color=Highlight>Heaven's Clarity</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Sheathed Stance</color>/<color=Highlight>Drawn Stance</color> skills deal damage, the rates at which <color=Highlight>Qin Heart</color>/<color=Highlight>Sword Cadence</color> are obtained increase by {16}.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color>, inflict {6} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> on nearby targets, and enhance the next <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color>: its DMG Multiplier is increased by {7} and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> enhancement.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> removes <color=Highlight>Heaven's Clarity</color>.

<color=Title>Swordlight Ward</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Tonality Shift</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color> grants {8} stacks of <color=Highlight>Swordlight Ward</color>.
<color=Highlight>Swordlight Ward</color> stacks up to {9} times. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, {10} stacks of <color=Highlight>Swordlight Ward</color> can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by {11} for {12}s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

<color=Title>Sword Flight</color>
While in the <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> continuously consumes <color=Highlight>Flight Qi</color>.
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> state:
<color=Highlight>Sword Glide</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Severing Note: Ascendant</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Tonality Shift</color>.
- Exit the <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> state by:
1. Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color>.
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all <color=Highlight>Flight Qi</color>.

<color=Title>Sword Step</color>
While in the <color=Highlight><te href=141306>Sword Flight</te></color> state, hold <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
<color=Highlight>Sword Step</color> can only be cast once during <color=Highlight><te href=141306>Sword Flight</te></color>.

<color=Title>Qin Heart</color>
Can hold up to {13} points.
Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Sheathed Stance</color> skills grants <color=Highlight>Qin Heart</color>.
<color=Highlight>Qin Heart</color> cannot be gained while in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state.

<color=Title>Sword Cadence</color>
Can hold up to {14} points.
Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Drawn Stance</color> skills grants <color=Highlight>Sword Cadence</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sword Cadence</color> cannot be gained while in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state.

<color=Title>Heart Sword Intent</color>
Can hold up to {15} points.
Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> grants <color=Highlight>Heart Sword Intent</color>.

moves.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
moves.description:
Upon entering combat, gain {0} stacks of <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color>.

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> effect, gain <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> with stacks equal to the target's <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> stacks.
If Qingxiao already has <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> and the target's <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> stacks, Qingxiao's <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> stacks will be matched to the target's <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> stacks.

<color=Title><color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color></color>
After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> equal to Qingxiao's <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> stacks. This effect can only trigger {1} times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color>, if the target has <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color>, additionally inflict {2} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target. This effect can only trigger {3} times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color>, and any existing <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> effect becomes inactive.
<color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> stacks up to {4} times and lasts for {5}s.

moves.name: To Know, To Banish
moves.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal {0} more DMG per stack of <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> on the target, with an additional {2} per stack for the first {1} stacks.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven</color>.

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict {3} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Inkwash
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color> Stage 4.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
Moments after a <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, Qiuyuan becomes immune to the next instance of DMG he takes and casts <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> upon being attacked, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

moves.name: Through the Groves
moves.description:
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to dash forward for a distance, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Echo Skill DMG. If <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is cast upon being attacked by an enemy target, Qiuyuan becomes immune to this instance of DMG and stagnates nearby enemies, while gaining immunity to interruption during this <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color>.
Switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect from enemies.

<color=Title>Undaunted Wayfarer</color>
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to dash forward for a distance at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to the target, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
If there are no targets nearby, Qiuyuan will leap up and dash through the air by continuously consuming STA until it runs out. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to immediately end the dash and land. If there are targets nearby when Qiuyuan lands, deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets, considered as Echo Skill DMG. This skill can be cast in mid-air.

moves.name: Sundering Strike
moves.description:
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to targets within range, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
For every {1} of Qiuyuan's Crit. Rate over {0}, this skill increases the Crit. DMG of all nearby active Resonators in the team by {2} for {3}s, up to {4}.

moves.name: Attack the Must-Defend
moves.description:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Within a certain period of time after casting this skill, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color> Stage 3.

moves.name: Strike Before Ready
moves.description:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> equal to {0} of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered as Echo Skill DMG.
Grant {1} Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator, lasting for {2}s or until the Resonator is switched out.

moves.name: Tune Break: Sword
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Verdant Edge
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack - Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color>
When Qiuyuan reaches {0} points of <te href=141101>Swordster's Soliloquy</te>, his <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color>, which chains together up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Bamboo's Shade</color>
When Qiuyuan reaches {1} points of <te href=141101>Swordster's Soliloquy</te>, he gains the <color=Highlight>Bamboo's Shade</color> effect, granting all nearby active Resonators in the team {2} Echo Skill DMG Bonus for {3}s.

<color=Title>Inksplash of Mind</color>
When <te href=141101>Swordster's Soliloquy</te> is full, Qiuyuan enters the <color=Highlight>Inksplash of Mind</color> state for {4}s, during which <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save</color>.
In this state, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to consume Swordster's Soliloquy to perform Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach</color>, <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save</color>, and <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice</color> in order, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Performing <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach</color>, <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save</color>, or <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice</color> is considered as performing <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.
- Inksplash of Mind ends when Swordster's Soliloquy is used up.

<color=Title>Swordster's Soliloquy</color>
Qiuyuan can hold up to {5} points of Swordster's Soliloquy.
- {6} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> Stage 3.
- {7} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing each stage of Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash</color>.
- {8} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.
- {9} points of Swordster's Soliloquy is obtained when performing <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.
- Swordster's Soliloquy cannot be obtained in the Inksplash of Mind state.
- Swordster's Soliloquy is cleared when the Inksplash of Mind state ends.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Guts</color>
<color=Highlight>Press Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Highlight>Press Dodge</color> and attack the target while dodging, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):

moves.name: Party 'til Dawn!
moves.description:
Switching to <color=Highlight>Mk. {0} HMG</color> mode generates a field of Stagnation for {1}s, in which:
Rebecca fires the <color=Highlight>Mk. {2} HMG</color> automatically, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating <color=Highlight><te href=130803>Overload</te></color>. <color=Highlight>Press or hold Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>press Resonance Liberation</color> at intervals after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her <color=Highlight>Mk. {3} HMG</color>'s firepower and accumulate <color=Highlight><te href=130803>Overload</te></color> faster. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times.

Hitting targets with the standard firepower <color=Highlight>Mk. {7} HMG</color> grants {8} points.
Hitting targets with the enhanced firepower <color=Highlight>Mk. {9} HMG</color> grants {10} points.
Hitting targets with the twice-enhanced firepower <color=Highlight>Mk. {11} HMG</color> grants {12} points.

<color=Title>BOOM! Fireworks!</color>
After <color=Highlight>Mk. {13} HMG</color> mode ends or when <color=Highlight><te href=130803>Overload</te></color> is maxed, <color=Highlight>BOOM! Fireworks!</color> is automatically cast, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>BOOM! Fireworks!</color> ends <color=Highlight>Mk. {14} HMG</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Hold Resonance Liberation</color> while in <color=Highlight>Mk. {15} HMG</color> mode to immediatly cast <color=Highlight>BOOM! Fireworks!</color>.
- Leaving the <color=Highlight>Mk. {14} HMG</color> mode removes all <color=Highlight><te href=130803>Overload</te></color>.

<color=Title>Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!</color>
When in the <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil of <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> from shooting the ground and switches to the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> mode to spray lead at the enemy, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

Rebecca can inflict <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> and respond to <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> on targets.
Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>: When any Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG and inflicts the <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>, Rebecca triggers <color=Highlight>Hack - Meltdown</color> on the target. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every {0}s.

moves.name: Gloves Are Comin' Off!
moves.description:
<color=Title>Switch Gears!</color>
Upon casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, Rebecca can freely switch between the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> modes.
- The <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by {0}.
- The <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> mode allows Rebecca to ignore {1} of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> mode.

<color=Title>Hack - Shifting</color>
Rebecca inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every {2}s:
<color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!</color>.

<color=Title>Hack Response - Meltdown</color>
Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to all targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> within the range, considered Hack DMG.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>
At {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Huntress</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>. <color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>, which consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> to pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
During <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Huntress</color>, if <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> is at {4} points and Rebecca is not in the action of <color=Highlight>Tactical Dodge - Huntress</color>, <color=Highlight>release Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts</color>

<color=Title>Fervor</color>
Rebecca can hold up to {6} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color>.
<color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> restore <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> upon damaging the target.
<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> restores <color=Highlight><te href=130805>Fervor</te></color> upon damaging the target.
When <color=Highlight><te href=130804>A Girl Gets What She Wants!</te></color> is gained by casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!</color>, Rebecca restores {7} points of Fervor.

<color=Title>Hot Hand</color>
Rebecca can hold up to {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130806>Hot Hand</te></color>.
Regenerates over time at a rate of {9} points per second.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts</color> restores {10} points.

<color=Title>A Girl Gets What She Wants!</color>

Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the <color=Highlight><te href=130801>Huntress</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=130802>Guts</te></color> modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
<color=Highlight><te href=130806>Hot Hand</te></color> cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by {13} points per second.

- The first {6} stages: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- The next {7} stages: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- The last {8} stages: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

- The last {12} stages: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after landing to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>.

Rover can hold up to {13} points of <color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=130901>Electric Surge</te></color> is restored when <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Deterrence</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Thunderclap</color>, or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Repel</color> deals damage.

Entering <color=Highlight><te href=130903>Apex Resonance</te></color> restores <color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> to the max limit.
<color=Highlight><te href=130902>Thunder Rage</te></color> is restored when <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> deals damage.

moves.name: Within Infinity's Embrace
moves.description:
<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>
<color=Highlight>Hold Normal Attack</color> to consume two <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color> and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Based on the types of the <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color> consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming <color=Highlight>Rune: Trust</color> and <color=Highlight>Rune: Answer</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>.
- When consuming two <color=Highlight>Runes: Trust</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>.
- When consuming two <color=Highlight>Runes: Answer</color>, this skill gains the effect of <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color>.
When consuming <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color>, if Sigrika holds at least {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color>, consume {1} points to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, and <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> by {2}. Obtain a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=141203>Innate Gift?</te></color>.
When consuming <color=Highlight><te href=141201>Runes</te></color>, if <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color> is lower than {3} points, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color>. Every {4} points of <color=Highlight><te href=141206>Soliskin Vitality</te></color> consumed grants the current <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, and <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> {5} DMG Amplification.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color> deals Echo Skill DMG.

<color=Title>Runic Outburst</color>
Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).

<color=Title>Runic Chain Whip</color>
Stagnate nearby targets and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).

<color=Title>Runic Soliskin</color>
Pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).

<color=Title>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color> reaches {6} points, if <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> is not on Cooldown, press Resonance Skill to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM!</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color>. <color=Highlight>Hold Resonance Skill</color> to consume all <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered Echo Skill DMG).

<color=Title>Innate Gift?</color>
Sigrika can hold up to {7} stacks of <color=Highlight>Innate Gift?</color>. Each stack grants <color=Highlight>Runic Outburst</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Chain Whip</color>, <color=Highlight>Runic Soliskin</color> and <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> {8} DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts <color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name</color> or is switched off the field.

<color=Title>Rune</color>
Sigrika holds up to <color=Highlight>{9} Runes</color>. Without <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, Sigrika can only hold up to <color=Highlight>{10} Runes</color>. When Sigrika gains a new <color=Highlight>Rune</color> at max capacity, the existing <color=Highlight>Runes</color> shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost <color=Highlight>Rune</color>. With at least {11} points of <color=Highlight><te href=141202>Full Stop</te></color>, Sigrika can hold {12} additional Runes.
Hitting a target directly with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Elucidated</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Decipher</color> in the duration of the moves grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Trust</color>.
Hitting a target directly with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid</color> in the duration of the moves grants one <color=Highlight>Rune: Answer</color>.

<color=Title>Full Stop</color>
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes</color>, gain {13} points of <color=Highlight>Full Stop</color>, up to 100 points.

<color=Title>Soliskin Vitality</color>
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains {14} points of <color=Highlight>Soliskin Vitality</color>, up to {15} points. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - In This Very Moment</color> resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.

When <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> is active, Suisui enters the <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color> state when casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Rippling Waters</color>.

This effect does not stack.
- Inflicting a target with <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limits of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> the target can receive by 3 for {1}s. This effect does not stack.
- Consuming <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> stacks on the target after landing a skill allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF by {2} and Havoc RES by {3} for {4}s. This effect does not stack.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

While casting this skill, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=111007>Cloud Breath</te></color> to pull in nearby targets and enter <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color>.

moves.name: Rippling Waters
moves.description:
Resonators in the team gain {0} All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color> when <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> is active.
Suisui exits <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color> and consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> consumed:

0 <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain <color=Highlight><te href=111009>Reflecting Shadows</te></color> for 6s. Resonators with <color=Highlight><te href=111009>Reflecting Shadows</te></color> have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> consumed:
- If <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> is active, Suisui may perform <color=Highlight><te href=111010>Plume Step</te></color> for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color>.

At least 400 <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> consumed:
- During this <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color> state, the active Resonator within the <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> deals more DMG if they have <color=Highlight><te href=111009>Reflecting Shadows</te></color>. For every {2} of Suisui's Energy Regen over {1}, the Resonator deals {3} more DMG, up to {4}.
- If <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> is active, Suisui may perform the second <color=Highlight><te href=111010>Plume Step</te></color> within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color>.

At least 600 <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first <color=Highlight><te href=111010>Plume Step</te></color>, all nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> gain the following effects for the duration of this <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color>:
- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator <color=Highlight><te href=111011>Undulating Mist</te></color>. When Resonators with <color=Highlight><te href=111011>Undulating Mist</te></color> consume <color=Highlight><te href=850180>Negative Status</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every {6} of Suisui's Energy Regen over {5}, the Resonator's ATK is increased by {7} for {9}s, up to {8}. <color=Highlight><te href=111011>Undulating Mist</te></color> lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When <color=Highlight><te href=111011>Undulating Mist</te></color> is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> is active, Suisui may perform the third <color=Highlight><te href=111010>Plume Step</te></color> within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color>.

<color=Title>Roaming Transcendent</color>
Lasts for {10}s.
During <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color>, Suisui will merge with <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform <color=Highlight><te href=111010>Plume Steps</te></color> at intervals based on the amount of <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> consumed when <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Rippling Waters</color> is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color> isn't active, she will exit the <color=Highlight><te href=111004>Roaming Transcendent</te></color> state.

<color=Title>Plume Step</color>
Performing <color=Highlight><te href=111010>Plume Step</te></color> grants <color=Highlight><te href=111009>Reflecting Shadows</te></color> to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on all enemies within the <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color>, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight><te href=111003>Ceaseless Landscape</te></color>.

moves.name: Lambent Gold
moves.description:
<color=Title>Zephyr Stance</color>
Suisui is in <color=Highlight><te href=111005>Zephyr Stance</te></color> by default. When in <color=Highlight><te href=111005>Zephyr Stance</te></color>, Suisui can obtain <color=Highlight><te href=111007>Cloud Breath</te></color> through certain skills.

<color=Title>Drizzle Stance</color>
Entering <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color> clears all <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color>.
During <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color>:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via <color=Highlight>Dodge skills</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1</color>.
After entering <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color> for 15s, Suisui ends <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color> and clears all <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> upon exiting the state.

<color=Title>Dodge - Parting Mist</color>
While performing attacks on the ground, press <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge - Parting Mist</color> at the cost of STA.
When in <color=Highlight><te href=111005>Zephyr Stance</te></color>, triggering a successful Dodge while casting <color=Highlight>Dodge - Parting Mist</color> restores <color=Highlight><te href=111007>Cloud Breath</te></color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color>, triggering a successful Dodge while casting <color=Highlight>Dodge - Parting Mist</color> restores <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color>, and does not reset the cycle of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance</color> within a certain period.

<color=Title>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> on hit.
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3</color>, continuously pull in nearby targets.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4</color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on the target on hit.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=111008>Floral Epistle</te></color> on hit.

<color=Title>Illuminating Dew</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color>, keep holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance</color> to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Swallow's Cut</color>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=111006>Drizzle Stance</te></color>, cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button while casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance</color>.
- Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Cloud Breath</color>

While <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by {1} when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> deals damage.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4</color> applies 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the targets hit.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> and dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Pressing <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after casting this skill triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> and dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Pressing <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after casting this skill triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance</color>
Pressing <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Pressing <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after casting this skill triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance</color> counts as casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance</color>
Pressing <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
Pressing <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after casting this skill triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 3</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance</color> counts as casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2</color>.

moves.name: Feather's Edge
moves.description:
<color=Title>Sword Stance Switch</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color>, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to switch to <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 1</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

While in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color>, press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to switch to <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 1</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Sword Stance Switch: Azure</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a short time after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> to switch to <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color> and cast <color=Highlight>Sword Stance Switch: Azure</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {0} <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

<color=Title>Sword Stance Switch: Feather</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a short time after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> to switch to <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color> and cast <color=Highlight>Sword Stance Switch: Feather</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {1} <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

moves.name: Hush of a Thousand Voices
moves.description:
<color=Title>Hush of a Thousand Voices</color>
Consume all <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restore {0} point of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>. This DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.

Upon casting this skill, obtain <color=Highlight>Voice upon Voice</color>. When casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, summon <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Voice upon Voice</color> cannot stack. Once <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling</color> is summoned, the <color=Highlight>Voice upon Voice</color> state is removed.
