moves.name: Skybound Feather
moves.description:
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restore {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
When <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color> deals damage, it applies 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: As the Wind Wills
moves.description:
Attacks the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {0} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK.
All Resonators in the team other than Yangyang: Xuanling gains <color=Highlight>Tonal Switch</color> for {1}s. After a Resonator with <color=Highlight>Tonal Switch</color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, that Resonator's Havoc DMG is Amplified by {2}.
This effect is reset upon casting this skill again.

moves.name: Tune Break - Sword
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
moves.description:
<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>
Yangyang: Xuanling is in <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color> by default. When <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> is depleted while in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to switch to <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color> and cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restoring {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> and {1} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>. This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> hits the target, consume {2} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on the target.
The <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> cycle is not reset within a short time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>. If casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> resets the cycle, summon a <color=Highlight>Wraith of Sound</color> to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> is depleted while in <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to switch to <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color> and cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restoring {4} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> and {5} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>. This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> hits, consume {6} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on the target.
The <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> cycle is not reset within a short time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>. If casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> resets the cycle, summon a <color=Highlight>Wraith of Sound</color> to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes {7} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> is restored to its maximum while in <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color>, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, gain <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color>: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> increases by {9}. When <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> ends, <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color> is removed. <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color> can be gained up to once every {10}s.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> applies {11} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the targets hit.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> is restored to its maximum while in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color>, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. After it hits a target, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color> is automatically cast.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, gain <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color>, which lasts {12}s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> or the next <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> is increased by {13}. <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> Stage 3 or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> Stage 3 ends. <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color> can be gained up to once every {14}s.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> applies {15} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the targets hit.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> is restored to its maximum while in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color> and airborne, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>.
Press or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color> enters <color=Highlight>Hark the Wind</color> for {16}s.

<color=Title>Hark the Wind</color>
While in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During <color=Highlight>Hark the Wind</color>, a Dodge Counter counts towards the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> cycle.

<color=Title>Feathered Oath</color>
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Feathered Oath</color> for {17}s. <color=Highlight>Feathered Oath</color> can be gained once every {18}s, stacking up to {19} times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> by {20}, up to {21}.

<color=Title>Refrain</color>
Before Yangyang: Xuanling's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

<color=Title>Melody</color>
<color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> has a maximum of {22} points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> restores {23} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
<color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> consumes <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes {24} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.

<color=Title>Azure Plume</color>
<color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> has a maximum of {25} points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color> restores {26} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> restores {27} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color> consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.

moves.name: Unbroken Vow
moves.description:
When a target has 1 to 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by {0}, up to {1}.

When a target has 4 to 6 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by {2}, up to {3}.

moves.name: One Life, One Blade
moves.description:
Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> raises the <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.

When nearby Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Windbound</color>. <color=Highlight>Windbound</color> can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to {0} times.

When <color=Highlight>Windbound</color> reaches {1} stacks, Yangyang: Xuanling removes all <color=Highlight>Windbound</color> and gains <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color>.
While <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color> lasts, when Yangyang: Xuanling casts <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, she summons <color=Highlight>Feather Release: Xuanling</color> to attack the target, applying {2} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the target.
<color=Highlight>Windbound</color> cannot be obtained while <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color> lasts.

Once <color=Highlight>Feather Release: Xuanling</color> is summoned, the <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color> state is removed.

moves.name: Zapstring's Dance
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring", dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Magnetic Roar
moves.description:
<color=Title>Magnetic Roar</color>
The puppet "Zapstring" deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Execution Mode</color>.

<color=Title>Execution Mode</color>
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> will trigger 1 <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color> when hitting a target.
Each stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> can only trigger 1 <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color>, up to 4 times.

<color=Title>Electromagnetic Blast</color>
Attack all targets marked with Forte Circuit <color=Highlight><te href=850029>Sinner's Mark</te></color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Lightning Execution</color>
Use Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.

moves.name: Thundering Wrath
moves.description: Command "Zapstring" to call for thunder to fall upon a large range, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Raging Storm
moves.description: Command puppet "Zapstring" to attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> in a large range.

moves.name: Strategist
moves.description: The incoming Resonator has their Electro DMG Amplified by {0} and Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by {1} for {2}s or until they are switched out.

moves.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Chameleon Cipher
moves.description:
<color=Title>Chameleon Cipher</color>
When Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color>, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. When it hits a target marked with <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color>, the <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color>, lasting for {0}s. <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color> deals Heavy Attack DMG.

<color=Title>Sinner's Mark</color>
Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Zapstring's Dance</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Thundering Wrath</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Roaring Storm</color> apply <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> to the target on hit.
<color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> is removed when Yinlin is switched out.

<color=Title>Punishment Mark</color>
When a target marked with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color> takes damage, <color=Highlight>Judgement Strike</color> will fall, triggering Coordinated Attacks to all targets marked with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. This can be triggered up to 1 time per second. <color=Highlight>Judgement Strike</color> deals Resonance Skill DMG.

<color=Title>Judgment Points</color>
Yinlin can hold up to {1} Judgement Points. Yinlin gains Judgement Points through the following ways:
Upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Raging Storm</color>
When Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Zapstring's Dance</color> hits a target
Upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color>;
When Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color> hits a target;
Upon casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color>.

moves.name: Pain Immersion
moves.description: After using Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color>, Yinlin's Crit. Rate is increased by {0} for {1}s.

moves.name: Deadly Focus
moves.description: The damage of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> is increased by {0} when hitting targets marked with <color=Highlight><te href=850029>Sinner's Mark</te></color>, and Yinlin's ATK is increased by {1} for {2}s when this is triggered.

moves.name: Frosty Punches
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
- When Frost is full, hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color>.
- When Frost is full during the <color=Highlight>Fortune Rolling</color> state, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color>. If Youhu cannot cast <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color> at the moment, perform <color=Highlight><te href=850045>Lucky Draw</te></color> once instead.
<color=Highlight>Youhu can obtain Frost in the following ways:</color>
- When Frost is not full, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> to enter the <color=Highlight>Fortune Rolling</color> state and restore Frost over time.
- When <color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color> hit a target.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack: Frostfall</color>
Youhu dashes forward, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, and performs <color=Highlight><te href=850045>Lucky Draw</te></color> once.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
When Youhu possesses no <color=Highlight>Antique</color>, quickly press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack Button</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to thrust forward, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, and perform <color=Highlight><te href=850045>Lucky Draw</te></color> once.

moves.name: Scroll Divination
moves.description:
Youhu smashes her scroll down at the enemy, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, restoring HP for all party members nearby, and performs <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color> once.

<color=Title>Lucky Draw</color>
Youhu obtains a random <color=Highlight>Antique</color> after the <color=Highlight>Lucky Draw</color>. With an <color=Highlight>Antique</color>, her next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> will activate the corresponding <color=Highlight>Antique Appraisal</color>.
Only one <color=Highlight>Antique</color> can exist at a time, and the newly drawn <color=Highlight>Antique</color> will replace the existing one.

<color=Title>Antique Appraisal</color>
- <color=Highlight>Chime</color>: Attack the enemy with a Chime, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Chime can effectively reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength.
- <color=Highlight>Ruyi</color>: Batter the enemy with a Ruyi, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Ruyi has a higher DMG Multiplier.
- <color=Highlight>Ding</color>: Ram into the enemy on a Ding, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Ding can effectively break the enemy's stance.
- <color=Highlight>Mask</color>: Throw a Mask at enemies in front, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Mask can pull in enemies along its path.

moves.name: Fortune's Favor
moves.description:
Youhu hurls her scroll at the enemy, causing a <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> blast in the area.
On the blast, four buttons will appear. Choose a button within the specified time to obtain the corresponding <color=Highlight><te href=850046>Antique</te></color>. Otherwise, obtain one random <color=Highlight>Antique</color>.

moves.name: Treasured Piece
moves.description: Restore HP for all nearby party members based on {0} of the healing provided by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scroll Divination</color> when Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Antique Appraisal</color> is cast.

moves.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Rare Find
moves.description: Gain {0} Glacio DMG Bonus for {1}s upon casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Scroll of Wonders</color>.

moves.name: Scroll of Wonders
moves.description: Toss out the scroll and perform <color=Highlight><te href=850045>Lucky Draw</te></color> once.

moves.name: Timeless Classics
moves.description: The incoming Resonator has their Coordinated Attack DMG Amplified by {0} for {1}s.

moves.name: Poetic Essence
moves.description:
At four Auspices, hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button to release <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG, while restoring HP for all nearby party members.
Youhu can hold up to four Auspices.

<color=Title>Poetic Essence</color>
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color> to enemies within the range and additionally obtain one of the following effects based on the Auspice combination:
- <color=Highlight>Free Verse</color>: Four different types Auspices. Additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of hit enemies.
- <color=Highlight>Antithesis</color>: A pair of Auspices. Increase <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color>'s DMG by {0}.
- <color=Highlight>Double Pun</color>: Two pairs of Auspices. Additionally restore HP for all nearby party members.
- <color=Highlight>Triplet</color>: Three identical Auspices. Increase <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color>'s DMG by {1}.
- <color=Highlight>Perfect Rhyme</color>: Four identical Auspices. Simultaneously activate the effects of <color=Highlight>Free Verse</color>, <color=Highlight>Double Pun</color>, and <color=Highlight>Triplet</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Poetic Essence</color> removes all Auspices.

<color=Title>Auspice</color>
- Youhu gains an Auspice through <color=Highlight>Antique Appraisal</color>. Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> while holding an <color=Highlight>Antique</color> to receive the corresponding Auspice.
- Youhu unlocks <color=Highlight>Antiques</color> by casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scroll Divination</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Scroll of Wonders</color>, Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Frostfall</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fortune's Favor</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.

moves.name: Leihuangquan
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Yuanwu performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Yuanwu consumes STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Yuanwu consumes STA to launch a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Leihuang Master
moves.description:
<color=Title>Thunder Wedge</color>
Yuanwu summons <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, and forms a <color=Highlight>Thunder Field</color> centered on the <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color>. <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> lasts for {0}s.
Forte Circuit <color=Highlight>Rumbling Spark</color> and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Blazing Might</color> will immediately detonate Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> on the field, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

<color=Title>Thunder Field</color>
The active character gains the effects below when in the <color=Highlight>Thunder Field</color>: a Coordinated Attack from Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> is triggered when attacks hit a target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. This can be triggered once every {1}s. The effect lasts for {2}s.

moves.name: Blazing Might
moves.description: Awaken the power of thunder and provide Forte Circuit <color=Highlight>Lightning Infused</color> status to all characters on a nearby team for {0}s, then perform a powerful blow that deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Thunderous Determination
moves.description: The DMG multiplier of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Uprising</color> is increased by {0}, and its reduction efficiency of enemy Vibration Strength is enhanced.

moves.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Reserved Confidence
moves.description: The ranges of the Resonance Skills <color=Highlight>Thunder Field</color> and <color=Highlight>Thunder Uprising</color> are greatly expanded. When switched off the field during combat, if "Readiness" is not full, Yuanwu will automatically leave {0} Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> in place.

moves.name: Thunder Bombardment
moves.description: Attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Lightning Manipulation
moves.description: Yuanwu unleashes thunderbolts in an area centered around the skill target, greatly reducing the Vibration Strength of enemies upon impact.

moves.name: Unassuming Blade
moves.description:
<color=Title>Rumbling Spark</color>
When "Readiness" is full, hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to consume all "Readiness" and cast <color=Highlight>Rumbling Spark</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and entering the <color=Highlight>Lightning Infused</color> state.

<color=Title>Thunder Uprising</color>
When "Readiness" is full, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> will be replaced with <color=Highlight>Thunder Uprising</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Lightning Infused</color>
The character in <color=Highlight>Lightning Infused</color> state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.
When Yuanwu is in this state:
-<color=Highlight>Basic Attacks</color>: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-<color=Highlight>Heavy Attacks</color>: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-<color=Highlight>Dodge Counters</color>: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> within {0}s after casting a <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> or a successful <color=Highlight>Counterattack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thunderweaver</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-Does not recover "Readiness".

<color=Title>Readiness</color>
Yuanwu can hold up to {1} "Readiness".
When Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> is on the field, Yuanwu gains {2} "Readiness" every second, even when he is not the active character;
When Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thunder Wedge</color> hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains {3} "Readiness".

Lightning Infused Basic Attack Stage 3 DMG

moves.name: Routine Negotiation
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
After performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> at the right time to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Breakthrough</color>, which can be followed by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> by pressing Normal Attack again.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a plunging attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Then press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> at the right time to cast Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Breakthrough</color>.

moves.name: Restless Watch
moves.description:
<color=Title>Standard Defense Protocol</color>
Attack the target to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and enter a block stance. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, recovering 10 points of <te href=850063>Redundant Energy</te> and Stagnating the target on hit.
When attacked by an enemy while in block stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then cast <color=Highlight>Pinpoint Strike</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {0}. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by {3} within the next {2}s.

<color=Title>Crisis Response Protocol</color>
When Zani is not in <color=Highlight><te href=850064>Inferno Mode</te></color> and has full <te href=850063>Redundant Energy</te>, her <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crisis Response Protocol</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. After releasing <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button or when the stance duration ends, consume all Redundant Energy to cast <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, which is also considered <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color>.
When attacked by an enemy in while in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and consume all Redundant Energy to cast <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (also considered <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color>), Stagnating the target, and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {1}. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by {3} within the next {2}s.
Casting <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color> or <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color> sends Zani into <color=Highlight>Sunburst</color> mode and inflicts a stack of <te href=850066>Heliacal Ember</te> upon the target on hit. The last stage of the attack recovers <te href=850065>Blaze</te>.

<color=Title>Sunburst</color>
The <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> DMG dealt by Zani to the target is Amplified by {4}.

moves.name: Between Dawn and Dusk
moves.description:
<color=Title>Rekindle</color>
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, increasing Max <te href=850065>Blaze</te> from {0} to {1} and granting {2} Blazes. When in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, the DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack is increased.

<color=Title>The Last Stand</color>
When in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>The Last Stand</color> becomes available when Blaze is lower than {3} or after {4}s in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>The Last Stand</color> deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and ends the <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.

moves.name: Immediate Execution
moves.description: Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

moves.name: Beacon For the Future
moves.description: Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> equal to {0} of Zani's ATK and removing all stacks of <te href=850066>Heliacal Ember</te> inflicted upon the target. Each stack increases the DMG dealt by {1}. This DMG is considered <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> DMG. The Spectro DMG dealt by other Resonators in the team to the target marked by <color=Highlight>Heliacal Ember</color> is Amplified by {2} for {3}s.

moves.name: Tune Break: Gauntlets
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: There Will Be A Light
moves.description:
<color=Title>Heliacal Ember</color>
When Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> upon a target, immediately trigger the DMG of all Spectro Frazzle stacks and convert Spectro Frazzle into an equal number of Heliacal Embers. Every time the conversion happens, Zani obtains Blaze based on the stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted. Heliacal Ember is capped at {0} stacks, with each stack lasting for {1}s. Heliacal Ember stacks are counted toward the Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.

<color=Title>Scorching Light</color>
When Zani is in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> become available, which deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> that is considered both Heavy Attack DMG and <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> DMG.
When Blaze is no less than {2}, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Standard Defense Protocol</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, during which Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early when Zani is switched off the field. While in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, release <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button within a certain time to consume Blaze and perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>.
When attacked in a certain time after entering <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, consuming Blazes and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {3}. Zani's DMG taken within the next {4}s is reduced by {5}.
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, consuming up to {6} Blazes on hit, with each Blaze increasing the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>. If <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1</color> is interrupted, press <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> again to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2</color>.
Upon releasing the button after a certain time or when <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color> ends, immediately perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
When Blaze is no less than {2}, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>. After entering <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately replaces the current <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>.
After performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, press <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color> at the cost of Blaze.
After performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
If <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is not replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color> after a successful Dodge and Zani has no less than {2} Blazes, press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> at the cost of Blazes.

<color=Title>Redundant Energy</color>
Zani can hold up to 100 Redundant Energy.
Obtain Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Immediate Execution</color>.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Standard Defense Protocol</color>.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting <color=Highlight>Pinpoint Strike</color>.
Cannot obtain Redundant Energy while in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.

<color=Title>Blaze</color>
Blaze is capped at 100 when not in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.
Blaze is capped at 150 in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color> or <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color> grants 10 Blazes.
Every stack of Heliacal Ember converted from <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> grants 5 Blazes.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rekindle</color> grants 50 Blazes.

moves.description: Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Immediate Execution</color> gives {0} Spectro DMG Bonus for {1}s.

moves.name: Fear No Pain
moves.description: When in <color=Highlight><te href=850173>Ready Stance</te></color>, all DMG taken is reduced by {0}.

moves.name: Dimming Brush
moves.description:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform an attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Heavy Attack does not reset the Basic Attack cycle.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks while in mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

moves.name: Manifestation
moves.description:
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. If <te href=850028>Afflatus</te> is no less than 60, consume 60 Afflatus to summon <color=Highlight><te href=850026>Phatasmic Imprint</te> - Left</color> and <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Right</color>.
-Press the button on the ground to summon the Phantasmic Imprints on the ground.
-Hold the button on the ground or press the button in mid-air to summon the Phantasmic Imprints in mid-air.

moves.name: Living Canvas
moves.description:
Summon <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirits</color> for assistance.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<color=Title>Inklit Spirit</color>
When the active Resonator deals DMG, an <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirit</color> will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-For {0}s after dealing DMG, 1 <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirit</color> is summoned per second. This effect can trigger once per second. Damage dealt by an Inklit Spirit does not trigger this effect.
-Up to {1} <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirit</color> can be summoned every second, and up to {2} in total.
-This effect lasts for {3}s, or until max <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirits</color> are summoned.

moves.name: Calligrapher's Touch
moves.description: When casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>, ATK is increased by {0} for {2}s. This can be stacked up to {1} time(s).

moves.name: Tune Break: Rectifier
moves.description: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

moves.name: Flourish
moves.description: After Outro Skill is cast, restore {0} Resonance Energy for the incoming Resonator.

moves.name: Radiant Ruin
moves.description: Attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

moves.name: Carve and Draw
moves.description: The incoming Resonator has their Glacio DMG Amplified by {0} and Resonance Skill DMG Amplified by {1} for {2}s or until they are switched out.

moves.name: Ink and Wash
moves.description:
<color=Title>Phantasmic Imprint</color>
Zhezhi may summon <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprints</color> at the cost of Afflatus when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color> or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color>.
Up to 1 of each of <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Left</color>, <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Middle</color>, and <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Right</color> can exist at the same time, each lasting for {0}s.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Conjuration</color>
The 5 moves below consume STA to perform <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.
-Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color>.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> while in mid-air.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.
If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, consume 30 Afflatus to summon a <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Middle</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius</color>
When a <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is nearby, the Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color>, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Move to the location of the <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color>, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is in mid-air.
-Gain 1 stack of Painter's Delight, lasting for {1}s and stacking up to 2 times.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith</color>
When a <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color> is nearby and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Lose all stacks of Painter's Delight
-Move to the location of the <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color>, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing greater <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG, additionally increasing the Basic Attack DMG Bonus by {2} for {3}s. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is in mid-air.

<color=Title>Afflatus</color>
Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.
Normal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.
Casting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.
